observations: aws ecs run-task --cluster <c> --task-definition <family[:rev]> [...] — Launch a one-shot (non-service-managed) task. Useful for scheduled batch jobs, migrations, ad-hoc debugging. Skip --launch-type if a default capacity-provider strategy is set on the cluster.

name: ecs.launch-types.cmd.aws-ecs-create-cluster
observations: aws ecs create-cluster --cluster-name <name> [--capacity-providers ...] [--default-capacity-provider-strategy ...] — Create a new ECS cluster with optional capacity-provider bindings + default strategy.

name: ecs.launch-types.cmd.aws-ecs-put-cluster-capacity-providers
observations: aws ecs put-cluster-capacity-providers --cluster <name> --capacity-providers <cps> --default-capacity-provider-strategy <strategy> — Update capacity-provider bindings on an existing cluster (atomic — must include the full list).

name: ecs.launch-types.cmd.aws-ecs-create-capacity-provider
observations: aws ecs create-capacity-provider --name <name> --auto-scaling-group-provider <args> — Create an EC2-ASG-backed capacity provider with managed-scaling parameters.

name: ecs.launch-types.cmd.aws-ssm-get-parameter-ami
observations: aws ssm get-parameter --name /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/<variant>/recommended/image_id — Resolve the latest ECS-Optimized AMI ID for a variant. Use in CloudFormation/Terraform for always-fresh AMIs.

name: ecs.nitro-baremetal.cmd.aws-ec2-describe-instance-types-metal
observations: aws ec2 describe-instance-types --filters Name=instance-type,Values='*.metal*' --query 'InstanceTypes[].InstanceType' — Enumerate available .metal instance types in the current region.

name: ecs.nitro-baremetal.cmd.lscpu-vmx-svm
observations: lscpu | grep -E 'vmx|svm|Virtualization' — Confirm CPU virtualization extensions are exposed (Intel VT-x or AMD-V). On bare-metal: present. On virtualized Nitro: absent (unless instance type supports nested-virt).

name: ecs.networking.cmd.aws-ecs-put-account-setting-awsvpc-trunking
observations: aws ecs put-account-setting --name awsvpcTrunking --value enabled — Opt the account into ENI trunking. Required before ECS_ENABLE_HIGH_DENSITY_ENI=true on the agent will increase task density.

name: ecs.networking.cmd.curl-tmds-task
observations: container$ curl -s ${ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4}/task — From inside a task container, fetch task-level metadata via TMDS v4. Returns task ARN, family, revision, container list, network config.

name: ecs.networking.cmd.curl-tmds-stats
observations: container$ curl -s ${ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4}/task/stats — From inside a task, fetch live cgroup-derived stats for all containers in the task — CPU usage, memory usage, network rx/tx bytes. v4-only.

name: ecs.networking.cmd.aws-ec2-describe-network-interfaces-task
observations: aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=description,Values='*<cluster>/<task-id>*' — Find the ENI attached to a specific awsvpc task. Useful when debugging connectivity — get the ENI's private IP, security groups, subnet.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.userns-remap
observations: daemon.json.userns-remap: User-namespace remap. `default` uses the `dockremap` user; or specify `<user>` / `<user>:<group>`. Requires entries in /etc/subuid + /etc/subgid. Mutually exclusive with `--privileged`, `--ipc=host`, `--net=host`, `--pid=host` containers — those refuse to start when remap is on.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.userland-proxy-path
observations: daemon.json.userland-proxy-path: Path to the docker-proxy binary if you need a custom build.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.dns-opts
observations: daemon.json.dns-opts: resolv.conf options (e.g. `["ndots:1","timeout:2"]`). Critical for k8s-style cluster DNS performance.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-network-opts
observations: daemon.json.default-network-opts: Default network driver options keyed by driver name. e.g. `{"bridge": {"com.docker.network.bridge.enable_ip_masquerade": "true"}}`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.allow-direct-routing
observations: daemon.json.allow-direct-routing: Allow remote access to published ports on container IPs (skips standard iptables-based routing).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.max-download-attempts
observations: daemon.json.max-download-attempts: Max retries per layer pull on transient errors.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.cluster-store-opts
observations: daemon.json.cluster-store-opts: Legacy swarm KV options.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.ip-forward-no-drop
observations: daemon.json.ip-forward-no-drop: Don't set the FORWARD chain default to DROP when enabling IP forwarding.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.memory
observations: container-run-flag.--memory, -m: Hard memory limit. Hitting it triggers OOM-killer; container exits with code 137. Always set in production.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.memory-swappiness
observations: container-run-flag.--memory-swappiness: Tune kernel swappiness for the container.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cpuset-mems
observations: container-run-flag.--cpuset-mems: NUMA memory nodes the container can allocate from.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.bind-create-src
observations: mount-spec.bind-create-src: Auto-create source path if it doesn't exist (matches `-v` legacy behavior). Default `--mount` errors out — use this opt-in to mirror -v.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.volume-nocopy
observations: mount-spec.volume-nocopy: Don't copy container's pre-existing dir contents into a new volume.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.DOCKER_API_VERSION
observations: env.DOCKER_API_VERSION: Pin the API version. Useful for ABI-tied scripts.

name: docker.engine.cfg.storage-opts.dm.basesize
observations: storage-opts.dm.basesize: devicemapper-thinpool legacy: base device size for new containers.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.add-runtime
observations: daemon.json.add-runtime: CLI form of `runtimes` map. e.g. `--add-runtime youki=/usr/local/bin/youki`. Equivalent to a single entry under `runtimes`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.validate
observations: daemon.json.validate: `dockerd --validate` checks the daemon config and exits without starting. Use in CI before rolling new daemon.json into prod.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.restart
observations: container-run-flag.--restart: Daemon-managed restart policy. `unless-stopped` ≈ `always` but doesn't restart after explicit `docker stop`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cap-add
observations: container-run-flag.--cap-add: Add a Linux capability. Common: NET_ADMIN (tcpdump), SYS_PTRACE (strace), SYS_ADMIN (mounts), NET_RAW (ping).

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.label
observations: container-run-flag.--label, -l: Set metadata labels on the container.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.platform
observations: container-run-flag.--platform: Force platform on multi-arch images. e.g. `linux/amd64`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.json-file.env-regex
observations: log-driver-options.env-regex (json-file): Regex form of `env`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.fluentd-async-reconnect-interval
observations: log-driver-options.fluentd-async-reconnect-interval: Reconnect interval (ms) when async. Useful when address is a Consul service that resolves multiple IPs.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.gelf.tag
observations: log-driver-options.tag (gelf): Tag template for GELF messages.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.type
observations: mount-spec.type: Mount type. cluster = swarm-only.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.DOCKER_CONFIG
observations: env.DOCKER_CONFIG: Override CLI config dir (auths, contexts, plugins).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.exec-root
observations: daemon.json.exec-root: Root dir for runtime exec state files (container OCI bundles, etc.). On tmpfs by default — wiped on reboot, which is fine.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.log-opts
observations: daemon.json.log-opts: Default log-driver options. Keys depend on selected driver. ALL VALUES MUST BE STRINGS in JSON (booleans/numbers must be quoted: `"max-file": "3"`).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.max-concurrent-downloads
observations: daemon.json.max-concurrent-downloads: Max parallel layer downloads per pull. Bump for large images on fast networks.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.raw-logs
observations: daemon.json.raw-logs: Emit timestamps without ANSI colors (logs to journals/files cleanly).

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.device
observations: container-run-flag.--device: Pass a host device through (e.g. `/dev/sda`, `/dev/nvidia0`).

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.gelf.gelf-address
observations: log-driver-options.gelf-address: GELF endpoint. udp://host:12201 or tcp://host:12201.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.gelf.gelf-tcp-max-reconnect
observations: log-driver-options.gelf-tcp-max-reconnect: Max TCP reconnect attempts.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.mtu
observations: daemon.json.mtu: MTU of the default bridge. Lower (e.g. 1450) on hosts behind GRE/IPsec tunnels — without this, large packets are silently dropped (TCP works for small flows, breaks on >MTU writes).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.fixed-cidr-v6
observations: daemon.json.fixed-cidr-v6: IPv6 subnet for the default bridge. e.g. `2001:db8:1::/64`. Required (with `ipv6: true`) for IPv6 on the default bridge.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.dns-search
observations: daemon.json.dns-search: DNS search domains for containers.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-shm-size
observations: daemon.json.default-shm-size: Default /dev/shm size for new containers. Bump for shared-memory-heavy workloads (Postgres, Chromium-headless).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.insecure-registries
observations: daemon.json.insecure-registries: Registries the daemon will talk to over HTTP / with self-signed TLS. e.g. `["localhost:5000","10.0.0.0/8"]`. Common for in-cluster pull-through caches.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.max-concurrent-uploads
observations: daemon.json.max-concurrent-uploads: Max parallel layer uploads per push.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.node-generic-resource
observations: daemon.json.node-generic-resource: User-defined resources advertised by the swarm node (e.g. `["GPU=UUID1","GPU=UUID2"]`).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-gateway-v6
observations: daemon.json.default-gateway-v6: Default gateway IPv6 for the default bridge.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.bip-bridge
observations: daemon.json.bridge: Network bridge interface name to attach containers to.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.no-new-privs
observations: daemon.json.no-new-privileges: Daemon-wide default for the no-new-privileges security flag on new containers.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.security-opt
observations: container-run-flag.--security-opt: Security options. Common: `seccomp=<file>|unconfined`, `apparmor=<profile>`, `label=<…>`, `no-new-privileges:true`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cpuset-cpus
observations: container-run-flag.--cpuset-cpus: CPUs to allow execution on. e.g. `0-3` or `0,2`. Pinning for NUMA / latency-sensitive workloads.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.read-only
observations: container-run-flag.--read-only: Mount root fs read-only. Combine with `--tmpfs /tmp` etc. for writable scratch. Hardening best-practice for stateless services.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.health-start-period
observations: container-run-flag.--health-start-period: Initial wait before counting failures. Lets the app start without flapping unhealthy.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.json-file.labels
observations: log-driver-options.labels (json-file): Daemon-wide allowlist of label keys included in log entries.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.json-file.labels-regex
observations: log-driver-options.labels-regex (json-file): Regex form of `labels`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.syslog.syslog-address
observations: log-driver-options.syslog-address: Syslog endpoint. Forms: tcp://host:514, udp://host:514, tcp+tls://host:514, unix:///dev/log.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.gelf.gelf-compression-type
observations: log-driver-options.gelf-compression-type: Compression for UDP GELF. Set `none` for low-CPU/MTU-tuned setups.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.gelf.gelf-tcp-reconnect-delay
observations: log-driver-options.gelf-tcp-reconnect-delay: Delay between TCP reconnect attempts.

name: docker.engine.cfg.storage-opts.zfs.fsname
observations: storage-opts.zfs.fsname: ZFS dataset for daemon storage. Override for non-default ZFS layout.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.tlskey
observations: daemon.json.tlskey: Private key matching tlscert.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.userland-proxy
observations: daemon.json.userland-proxy: Use docker-proxy binary for loopback (host:container) traffic. Disabling pushes more work into iptables and may improve perf, but breaks some odd cases (port-publish from same container that originates the connection).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.runtimes
observations: daemon.json.runtimes: Map of named runtimes. Two forms: drop-in (`{"path":"/path/to/binary"}`) for runc-compatible (e.g. youki); shim (`{"runtimeType":"io.containerd.runsc.v1"}`) for runtimes shipping their own containerd shim.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.metrics-addr
observations: daemon.json.metrics-addr: Prometheus metrics endpoint. e.g. `127.0.0.1:9323`. Bound to loopback by default — exposing on `0.0.0.0` opens an info-leak surface.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.experimental
observations: daemon.json.experimental: Enable experimental features. Required for some metrics/feature combinations.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.memory-swap
observations: container-run-flag.--memory-swap: Memory + swap limit. Set to -1 for unlimited swap. Must be ≥ --memory.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.pids-limit
observations: container-run-flag.--pids-limit: Container-level pids cgroup limit. -1 also = unlimited. Defense against fork bombs / leaked-process accumulation.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.sysctl
observations: container-run-flag.--sysctl: Set sysctls inside the container's namespaces. Only namespaced sysctls are settable (e.g. `net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range`).

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.fluentd-address
observations: log-driver-options.fluentd-address: Fluentd collector socket. tcp://host:24224 or unix:///path/to/fluentd.sock. tcp default scheme.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.fluentd-write-timeout
observations: log-driver-options.fluentd-write-timeout: Write-call timeout to fluentd daemon. Default = block forever — set this in production.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.DOCKER_HOST
observations: env.DOCKER_HOST: CLI's daemon address. ssh://user@host accepted; password auth NOT supported (must use ssh-agent / passwordless key).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.pidfile
observations: daemon.json.pidfile: Daemon PID file. Set with `--pidfile` flag or daemon.json. Stale pidfile after crash can prevent restart — clean up if `dockerd` complains 'pid file found, ensure docker is not running'.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.bridge
observations: daemon.json.bridge: Network bridge to attach containers to (default `docker0`). Detail in docker/networking. Setting to `none` disables the default bridge.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.cri-containerd
observations: daemon.json.cri-containerd: Start the bundled containerd with the CRI plugin (for Kubernetes integration).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.features
observations: daemon.json.features: Named feature flags. e.g. `{"containerd-snapshotter": true}` to opt into the containerd image store on a legacy install.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.builder
observations: daemon.json.builder: Builder-related daemon config. Most active surface lives in BuildKit / buildkitd.toml; this key is a dockerd-side hook.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.no-proxy
observations: daemon.json.no-proxy: Comma-separated NO_PROXY hosts/CIDRs.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.rootless
observations: daemon.json.rootless: Run dockerd in rootless mode (typically launched by RootlessKit). Detail in docker/security; here just the daemon-level toggle.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-gateway
observations: daemon.json.default-gateway: Default gateway IPv4 for the default bridge.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.init
observations: container-run-flag.--init: Inject docker-init/tini as pid 1. Forwards signals + reaps zombies. Fixes 'docker stop hangs' and zombie process leaks.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.device-cgroup-rule
observations: container-run-flag.--device-cgroup-rule: Add a rule to the cgroup devices allowlist (e.g. `c 1:3 mr` allow read/mknod on /dev/null major:minor).

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.json-file.max-size
observations: log-driver-options.max-size (json-file): Max single log file size before rotation. e.g. `10m`. THE knob to set — without it, json-file fills the disk on long-running containers.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.fluentd-retry-wait
observations: log-driver-options.fluentd-retry-wait: Sleep between retries.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.journald.labels-regex
observations: log-driver-options.labels-regex (journald): Regex form.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.journald.env
observations: log-driver-options.env (journald): Comma-separated env keys to include.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.bind-propagation
observations: mount-spec.bind-propagation: Bind-mount propagation. r-prefixed = recursive. shared = sub-mounts in either direction propagate. Detail in docker-docs-storage-bind-mounts.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.bind-recursive
observations: mount-spec.bind-recursive: Recursive bind behavior. `readonly` requires kernel ≥ 5.12; older kernels = read-write submounts.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.volume-opt
observations: mount-spec.volume-opt: Volume-driver options. e.g. for local + nfs: `volume-opt=type=nfs,volume-opt=device=…,volume-opt=o=addr=…`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.tmpfs-size
observations: mount-spec.tmpfs-size: Tmpfs upper bound.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.consistency
observations: mount-spec.consistency: macOS-only. Tunes filesystem coherence vs perf for Docker Desktop bind mounts.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.ipv6
observations: daemon.json.ipv6: Enable IPv6 on the default bridge. Linux-only.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.registry-mirrors
observations: daemon.json.registry-mirrors: List of preferred registry mirrors for Docker Hub pulls. e.g. `["https://mirror.gcr.io"]`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.cluster-store
observations: daemon.json.cluster-store: Legacy KV store for swarm classic. Effectively dead key on modern installs.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.feature
observations: daemon.json.feature: CLI-form `--feature key=true` equivalent of `features` map.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.network-control-plane-mtu
observations: daemon.json.network-control-plane-mtu: MTU for the swarm control-plane.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.log-driver
observations: container-run-flag.--log-driver: Per-container logging driver. Override of daemon-default. Re-creating the container is required to change.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.uts
observations: container-run-flag.--uts: UTS namespace. Only `host` allowed. Disallows --hostname/--domainname when host.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.gpus
observations: container-run-flag.--gpus: GPU pass-through. `all` for every GPU; `device=0,1` for specific. Requires NVIDIA Container Toolkit + nvidia runtime.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.health-timeout
observations: container-run-flag.--health-timeout: Max time per probe.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.pull
observations: container-run-flag.--pull: When to pull. `always` for fresh-bytes guarantees, `never` for air-gapped.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.syslog.syslog-tls-ca-cert
observations: log-driver-options.syslog-tls-ca-cert: CA cert for TLS-syslog.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.HTTP_PROXY
observations: env.HTTP_PROXY: Proxy used by both daemon and CLI for HTTP traffic (registry pulls, registry push). Honored by daemon when started with this in env (systemd drop-in convention).

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.NO_PROXY
observations: env.NO_PROXY: Hosts/CIDRs/wildcards to skip proxying. Forms: `1.2.3.4`, `1.2.3.4:80`, `example.com`, `.example.com`, `*`, comma-separated.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.live-restore
observations: daemon.json.live-restore: Keep containers running across daemon restart. Patch upgrades only (`YY.MM.x`); skipped major upgrades may break the reconnect. Daemon-options that change (bridge IP, graph driver) prevent the reconnect — containers must be stopped manually.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-address-pools
observations: daemon.json.default-address-pools: IP pools for new user-defined networks. Configure to avoid clashes with on-prem subnets. Add IPv6 pools to use deterministic v6 ranges instead of ULA.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.https-proxy
observations: daemon.json.https-proxy: HTTPS proxy URL.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.ipc
observations: container-run-flag.--ipc: IPC namespace mode: host|container:<id>|private|shareable|none. `shareable` (default) lets `--ipc=container:` work later.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.health-retries
observations: container-run-flag.--health-retries: Consecutive failures before marking unhealthy.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.user
observations: container-run-flag.--user, -u: User to run as: `<uid>` or `<name>`, optionally `:<gid|group>`. Override image USER.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.syslog.syslog-format
observations: log-driver-options.syslog-format: Wire format. rfc5424 has structured-data, rfc3164 is BSD legacy.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
observations: env.DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY: Equivalent to --tlsverify.

name: docker.engine.cfg.storage-opts.overlay2.override_kernel_check
observations: storage-opts.overlay2.override_kernel_check: Bypass overlay2 kernel-version check. Use only if you know your kernel supports OverlayFS but reports an older version (back-ported, e.g. RHEL 3.10.0-514).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.bip
observations: daemon.json.bip: IPv4 address (with prefix) for the default bridge. e.g. `172.18.0.1/16`. Pinning avoids subnet collisions with VPNs / on-prem networks.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.ip-forward
observations: daemon.json.ip-forward: Enable kernel `net.ipv4.ip_forward`. Disabling kills any cross-network routing — containers can't reach the internet through the bridge.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.icc
observations: daemon.json.icc: Inter-container communication on the default bridge. With `icc: false`, containers on the default bridge can't reach each other (must use user-defined network or explicit `--link`).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.init-path
observations: daemon.json.init-path: Path to docker-init binary. Override only if you ship a custom init.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.proxies
observations: daemon.json.proxies: Daemon-side HTTP/HTTPS proxy + bypass list. Takes precedence over env vars. e.g. `{"http-proxy":"http://proxy.example.com:3128","no-proxy":"*.test.example.com,.example.org,127.0.0.0/8"}`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cpu-quota
observations: container-run-flag.--cpu-quota: CFS quota in microseconds. With period 100k, quota 50k = 0.5 CPUs.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cgroupns
observations: container-run-flag.--cgroupns: Cgroup namespace mode.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.json-file.max-file
observations: log-driver-options.max-file (json-file): Number of rotated files kept. Only effective with max-size set.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.fluentd-sub-second-precision
observations: log-driver-options.fluentd-sub-second-precision: Emit nanosecond-precision event timestamps.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.journald.env-regex
observations: log-driver-options.env-regex (journald): Regex form.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.local.max-size
observations: log-driver-options.max-size (local): Max single log file size. Local driver rotates by default.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.local.max-file
observations: log-driver-options.max-file (local): Number of rotated files kept.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.DOCKER_CERT_PATH
observations: env.DOCKER_CERT_PATH: Dir containing ca.pem, cert.pem, key.pem.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM
observations: env.DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM: Default platform for `docker pull` / `docker build` / `docker run`. e.g. `linux/amd64`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.group
observations: daemon.json.group: Group that owns the docker.sock unix socket. Membership grants effective root on the host (an attacker can mount / and chroot). Treat docker-group membership as sudo membership.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.firewall-backend
observations: daemon.json.firewall-backend: Firewall backend: `iptables` or `nftables`. Pick `nftables` on modern systems where iptables is a compat wrapper.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-ulimits
observations: daemon.json.default-ulimits: Default ulimits for all new containers. e.g. `{"nofile":{"Name":"nofile","Soft":65536,"Hard":65536}}`. Common fix for 'too many open files' on busy services.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.init
observations: daemon.json.init: Inject docker-init as pid 1 by default for every container. Trades a tiny memory hit for correct signal-forward + zombie-reap.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.containerd-namespace
observations: daemon.json.containerd-namespace: Containerd namespace dockerd uses for its containers/images.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cpu-shares
observations: container-run-flag.--cpu-shares, -c: Relative CPU weight under contention. 1024 = baseline. NOT a hard cap.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.health-cmd
observations: container-run-flag.--health-cmd: Health-check shell command. Combine with --health-interval / --health-retries / --health-start-period.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.label-file
observations: container-run-flag.--label-file: Read labels from a file (one per line).

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.stop-signal
observations: container-run-flag.--stop-signal: Signal sent on `docker stop`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.stop-timeout
observations: container-run-flag.--stop-timeout: Grace period before SIGKILL.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.fluentd-buffer-limit
observations: log-driver-options.fluentd-buffer-limit: In-memory buffer size (events). Full buffer = call to write logs fails.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.volume-driver
observations: mount-spec.volume-driver: Volume driver (e.g. `local`, `rclone`).

name: docker.engine.cfg.storage-opts.overlay2.size
observations: storage-opts.overlay2.size: Per-container quota for overlay2 upperdir. Requires xfs+pquota or similar. Hard cap on writable-layer growth.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.data-root
observations: daemon.json.data-root: Root dir of persistent Docker state. Renaming an existing data-root requires daemon stop + manual move; the daemon doesn't migrate. Containerd image store keeps image layers under /var/lib/containerd regardless.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.tlsverify
observations: daemon.json.tlsverify: Use TLS and verify the client (mTLS). Required for any production-grade exposed TCP socket.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.host-gateway-ip
observations: daemon.json.host-gateway-ip: IP addresses the special `host-gateway` token resolves to in `--add-host=host:host-gateway`. Defaults to default-bridge IPs. Used for containers reaching the host without baking 172.x.0.1.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.log-level
observations: daemon.json.log-level: Daemon log level. `debug` for verbose troubleshooting (also `debug: true` shortcut).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.swarm-default-advertise-addr
observations: daemon.json.swarm-default-advertise-addr: Default swarm advertise interface/address. Swarm-only; otherwise irrelevant.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.mount
observations: container-run-flag.--mount: Verbose mount syntax. Required for volume-driver options, volume-subpath, and bind-create-src. See `mount-spec` scope for sub-keys.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.ulimit
observations: container-run-flag.--ulimit: Set ulimits in the container. e.g. `--ulimit nofile=65536:65536`. Daemon default via `default-ulimits`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.memory-reservation
observations: container-run-flag.--memory-reservation: Memory soft limit. Kernel attempts to keep below; doesn't OOM-kill.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.entrypoint
observations: container-run-flag.--entrypoint: Override the image's ENTRYPOINT. `--entrypoint=sh` is the canonical way to shell into a broken image.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.tmpfs
observations: container-run-flag.--tmpfs: Mount a tmpfs at the given path. Default tmpfs opts: `rw,noexec,nosuid,size=65536k`. Combine with --read-only for safe scratch space.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.json-file.compress
observations: log-driver-options.compress (json-file): Compress rotated logs (gzip).

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.DOCKER_CONTEXT
observations: env.DOCKER_CONTEXT: Pick a docker context for one command. Beats setting DOCKER_HOST manually per shell.

name: docker.engine.cfg.storage-opts.dm.thinpooldev
observations: storage-opts.dm.thinpooldev: devicemapper: explicit thin-pool device path.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.tls
observations: daemon.json.tls: Use TLS on TCP listeners. Implied by tlsverify.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.tlscert
observations: daemon.json.tlscert: Daemon's own TLS server cert.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.iptables
observations: daemon.json.iptables: Daemon-managed iptables rules for NAT, isolation, port-publish. Disabling = no DNAT for `-p` published ports. Detail of chains in docker/networking.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.ip6tables
observations: daemon.json.ip6tables: Daemon-managed ip6tables rules. Required for IPv6 packet filtering and port mapping. Auto-loads `ip6_tables` kernel module on most distros; needs manual `modprobe ip6_tables` inside Docker-in-Docker.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.ip-masq
observations: daemon.json.ip-masq: IP masquerading (SNAT) on the default bridge. Without this, container packets retain their internal IP, often filtered by external networks.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.no-new-privileges
observations: daemon.json.no-new-privileges: Set `no-new-privileges: true` by default for new containers. Equivalent to `--security-opt=no-new-privileges`. Forbids gaining new caps via setuid binaries — strong baseline hardening.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.http-proxy
observations: daemon.json.http-proxy: CLI flag form: `--http-proxy`. Same as `proxies.http-proxy`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.shutdown-timeout
observations: daemon.json.shutdown-timeout: Default shutdown grace before SIGKILL on daemon stop.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.log-format
observations: daemon.json.log-format: Daemon log output format: `text` or `json`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.cpu-rt-runtime
observations: daemon.json.cpu-rt-runtime: CPU real-time runtime budget for the parent cgroup. Cgroup v1 only.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.cluster-advertise
observations: daemon.json.cluster-advertise: Legacy swarm advertise.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.ip
observations: daemon.json.ip: Host IP for port publishing from the default bridge. Pin to a single interface to avoid binding to all.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.userns
observations: container-run-flag.--userns: User namespace mode. Only valid value is `host` — disables daemon-wide userns-remap for this container.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.workdir
observations: container-run-flag.--workdir, -w: Initial working directory.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.syslog.syslog-tls-key
observations: log-driver-options.syslog-tls-key: Client key for TLS-syslog.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.volume-subpath
observations: mount-spec.volume-subpath: Mount only a subdirectory of the volume into the container. Subdir must exist or mount fails.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.HTTPS_PROXY
observations: env.HTTPS_PROXY: HTTPS proxy. Takes precedence over HTTP_PROXY for https URLs (Go http.proxy semantics).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.bip6
observations: daemon.json.bip6: IPv6 address for the default bridge.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.cdi-spec-dirs
observations: daemon.json.cdi-spec-dirs: CDI spec directories. Used for vendored device drivers (NVIDIA via CDI).

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.log-opt
observations: container-run-flag.--log-opt: Per-container log driver options.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cap-drop
observations: container-run-flag.--cap-drop: Drop a Linux capability. `--cap-drop=ALL` + selective `--cap-add` is the least-privilege baseline.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.privileged
observations: container-run-flag.--privileged: All capabilities + host devices + AppArmor/seccomp disabled. Effectively root-on-host. Avoid; use targeted --cap-add and --device.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.source
observations: mount-spec.source / src: For volume = volume name (omit for anonymous); for bind = host path; for tmpfs = unused.

name: docker.engine.cfg.env.DOCKER_BUILDKIT
observations: env.DOCKER_BUILDKIT: Toggle BuildKit for `docker build`. Detail in docker/build-buildkit.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.tlscacert
observations: daemon.json.tlscacert: CA cert that signed allowed client certs. With tlsverify, only certs chained from this CA are accepted.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.log-driver
observations: daemon.json.log-driver: Default container logging driver. `local` recommended for new installs (rotation by default). Existing containers don't pick up changes — must be re-created.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.seccomp-profile
observations: daemon.json.seccomp-profile: Default seccomp profile. `builtin` = Docker's default (~50 syscalls blocked). `unconfined` = no seccomp (do not). Or path to custom JSON profile.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.label
observations: daemon.json.labels: Daemon-level labels (`key=value`). Surfaced in `docker info`. Used by orchestrators to schedule based on host attributes.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.oom-score-adjust
observations: daemon.json.oom-score-adjust: Daemon's own OOM-killer preference. Set to -500 to keep dockerd alive when host is under memory pressure.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.fixed-cidr-bridge
observations: daemon.json.fixed-cidr: IPv4 subnet allocated for default bridge containers (within `bip`).

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cpus
observations: container-run-flag.--cpus: CPU quota expressed as fractional cores. Translates to `cpu-period`/`cpu-quota` cgroup knobs.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.cpu-period
observations: container-run-flag.--cpu-period: CFS period (default 100000μs = 100ms). Combined with --cpu-quota = hard CPU cap.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.network
observations: container-run-flag.--network: Network to attach. Names of `docker network ls` rows, or `host` (no isolation), `none`, `container:<id>` (share another container's net ns).

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.pid
observations: container-run-flag.--pid: PID namespace mode. `host` (host pid ns — see all host processes), `container:<id>` (share another container's pid ns — debug-sidecar pattern). Combined with --cap-add=SYS_PTRACE for strace/gdb.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.shm-size
observations: container-run-flag.--shm-size: Size of /dev/shm.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.health-interval
observations: container-run-flag.--health-interval: Time between health checks.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.volumes-from
observations: container-run-flag.--volumes-from: Mount volumes from another container (legacy data-container pattern). See container-run --volumes-from in docker-docs-storage-volumes.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.env-file
observations: container-run-flag.--env-file: Load env vars from KEY=VALUE files.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.runtime
observations: container-run-flag.--runtime: OCI runtime for this container (runc | crun | io.containerd.kata.v2 | …).

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.json-file.env
observations: log-driver-options.env (json-file): Env-var keys included in log entries.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.fluentd-max-retries
observations: log-driver-options.fluentd-max-retries: Max retries (default = max uint32). Set lower to fail fast.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.tag
observations: log-driver-options.tag (fluentd): Per-message tag template. e.g. `docker.{{.Name}}`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.journald.labels
observations: log-driver-options.labels (journald): Comma-separated label keys included as journal fields.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.syslog.syslog-tls-cert
observations: log-driver-options.syslog-tls-cert: Client cert for TLS-syslog.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.local.compress
observations: log-driver-options.compress (local): Compress rotated files.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.readonly
observations: mount-spec.readonly / ro: Mount read-only inside the container.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.hosts
observations: daemon.json.hosts: List of sockets the daemon listens on. e.g. ["unix:///var/run/docker.sock","tcp://127.0.0.1:2375"]. CONFLICTS with `-H` flag set via systemd unit's ExecStart — daemon refuses to start if both define hosts. Convention: 2375 = no TLS, 2376 = TLS.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.storage-opts
observations: daemon.json.storage-opts: Driver-specific options as `key=value` strings. See `storage-opts` scope below for the per-driver knobs.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.dns
observations: daemon.json.dns: DNS server(s) for containers. Overrides /etc/resolv.conf. Use `["8.8.8.8","1.1.1.1"]` to bypass a broken corporate resolver.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.bridge-accept-fwmark
observations: daemon.json.bridge-accept-fwmark: In bridge networks, accept packets carrying this firewall mark/mask. Used for advanced policy routing setups.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.cgroup-parent
observations: daemon.json.cgroup-parent: Parent cgroup all containers nest under. e.g. `system.slice/docker.slice` to integrate with systemd accounting.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-ipc-mode
observations: daemon.json.default-ipc-mode: Default IPC mode (`shareable` or `private`). Private = the container has its own IPC namespace and can't be joined.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.selinux-enabled
observations: daemon.json.selinux-enabled: Enable SELinux support; requires SELinux running in enforcing/permissive on the host. Detail in docker/security.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.containerd
observations: daemon.json.containerd: Path to external containerd grpc socket. Setting it makes dockerd attach to a separately-managed containerd instead of starting one.

name: docker.engine.cfg.container-run-flag.health-start-interval
observations: container-run-flag.--health-start-interval: Health-check cadence during the start period.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.fluentd.fluentd-async
observations: log-driver-options.fluentd-async: If false, container fails to start when fluentd unreachable. true = fire-and-forget with buffer.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.journald.tag
observations: log-driver-options.tag (journald): Sets `CONTAINER_TAG` and `SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER` in the journal entry.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.bind-nonrecursive
observations: mount-spec.bind-nonrecursive: Don't include host sub-mounts in the container's view.

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.tmpfs-mode
observations: mount-spec.tmpfs-mode: Tmpfs file mode bits.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.storage-driver
observations: daemon.json.storage-driver: Classic storage driver name. Switching mid-life renders existing local images/containers inaccessible — must `docker save` / push first. Values: overlay2, fuse-overlayfs, btrfs, zfs, vfs, windowsfilter.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.fixed-cidr
observations: daemon.json.fixed-cidr: IPv4 subnet for the default bridge network (must be within `bip`).

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-cgroupns-mode
observations: daemon.json.default-cgroupns-mode: Default cgroup-namespace mode for new containers (`host` or `private`). Private hides the host's cgroup tree from the container.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.default-runtime
observations: daemon.json.default-runtime: Default OCI runtime. Override per-container with `docker run --runtime <name>`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.containerd-plugin-namespace
observations: daemon.json.containerd-plugins-namespace: Containerd namespace for plugins.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.debug
observations: daemon.json.debug: Shortcut for `log-level: debug`. Setting via daemon.json + SIGHUP is the recommended way to flip on debug logs without a full restart.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.exec-opts
observations: daemon.json.exec-opts: Runtime exec options. e.g. `["native.cgroupdriver=systemd"]` to make the daemon use systemd as the cgroup driver — required for kubelet integration on systemd hosts.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.cpu-rt-period
observations: daemon.json.cpu-rt-period: CPU real-time period for the parent cgroup. Cgroup v1 only.

name: docker.engine.cfg.daemon.json.authorization-plugins
observations: daemon.json.authorization-plugins: Names of authorization plugins (volume / log / network / authz extensions). Daemon refuses ops not allowed by all listed plugins.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.json-file.tag
observations: log-driver-options.tag (json-file): Tag template for log entries. Supports `{{.ID}}`, `{{.FullID}}`, `{{.Name}}`, `{{.ImageName}}`.

name: docker.engine.cfg.log-driver-options.syslog.syslog-facility
observations: log-driver-options.syslog-facility: RFC 5424 facility (daemon, local0..local7, etc.).

name: docker.engine.cfg.mount-spec.destination
observations: mount-spec.destination / dst / target: Container path (must be absolute).

name: docker.engine.cfg.storage-opts.btrfs.min_space
observations: storage-opts.btrfs.min_space: btrfs: minimum free space to keep on the volume; daemon refuses to create new layers below the threshold.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.ociVersion
observations: oci-config-json.ociVersion: Required. The OCI runtime spec version this config.json complies with (e.g. "1.0.2-dev", "1.1.0"). Runtime may reject versions it doesn't implement.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.gidMappings
observations: oci-config-json.linux.gidMappings: User namespace GID maps.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.timeOffsets
observations: oci-config-json.linux.timeOffsets: Per-clock offset in time namespace. Common clocks: monotonic, boottime.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.network.classID
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.network.classID: net_cls major/minor classid for tc(8).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.grpc.tcp_address
observations: containerd-toml.grpc.tcp_address: Optional TCP grpc listener (use TLS).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.grpc.max_recv_message_size
observations: containerd-toml.grpc.max_recv_message_size: Max grpc receive message size.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.metrics.grpc_histogram
observations: containerd-toml.metrics.grpc_histogram: Emit grpc latency histograms (more cardinality).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.user.uid
observations: oci-config-json.process.user.uid: User ID inside the container's user namespace.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.cwd
observations: oci-config-json.process.cwd: Working directory inside the container.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.hooks.poststop
observations: oci-config-json.hooks.poststop: Hooks after container destruction. Failures only logged.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.state
observations: containerd-toml.state: Runtime state dir (sockets, ttrpc shims).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.disabled_plugins
observations: containerd-toml.disabled_plugins: Plugin IDs to disable. e.g. `["io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri"]` to skip CRI on a non-k8s host.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.imports
observations: containerd-toml.imports: Additional config files to merge in (drop-in style).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.grpc.uid
observations: containerd-toml.grpc.uid: UID owning the grpc unix socket.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.metrics.address
observations: containerd-toml.metrics.address: Prometheus metrics endpoint.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.runtime.enable_selinux
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime".enable_selinux: Apply SELinux labels to containers.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.ExposedPorts
observations: oci-image-config.config.ExposedPorts: Ports the image expects to listen on. Default proto = tcp. Just metadata; doesn't auto-publish.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.Env
observations: oci-image-config.config.Env: Default env vars merged with `docker run -e`.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.Labels
observations: oci-image-config.config.Labels: Arbitrary metadata. Standard keys per opencontainers/image-spec annotation rules.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.rootfs.diff_ids
observations: oci-image-config.rootfs.diff_ids: Ordered diff_ids from base layer to top. Combined with tar-split to compute ChainID and ImageID.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.preserve-fds
observations: runc-cli-flag.--preserve-fds: Pass N additional fds beyond stdio + $LISTEN_FDS.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.docker-content-digest
observations: oci-distribution-header.Docker-Content-Digest: Server-asserted digest of returned content. Client verifies blob bytes against this header.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.env
observations: oci-config-json.process.env: Env vars as `KEY=VAL` strings.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.capabilities.bounding
observations: oci-config-json.process.capabilities.bounding: Bounding set of capabilities. Limits what setuid binaries can ever gain. Names: CAP_NET_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_PTRACE, etc.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.cgroupsPath
observations: oci-config-json.linux.cgroupsPath: Cgroup path: absolute = relative to cgroup mount root; relative = runtime-defined location. systemd form: `slice:prefix:name`.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.hooks.prestart
observations: oci-config-json.hooks.prestart: Deprecated. Hooks run after namespaces created, before pivot_root, in runtime namespace.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.hooks.createRuntime
observations: oci-config-json.hooks.createRuntime: Replaces prestart. Runtime-namespace hooks before pivot_root.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.netDevices
observations: oci-config-json.linux.netDevices: Network devices to move from host to container netns. Append `%d` to name for kernel-generated unique names.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.grpc.gid
observations: containerd-toml.grpc.gid: GID owning the grpc unix socket.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.runtime.disable_apparmor
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime".disable_apparmor: Skip applying AppArmor profiles.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.os.version
observations: oci-image-config.os.version: OS version (e.g. "10.0.14393.1066" on windows).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.capabilities.inheritable
observations: oci-config-json.process.capabilities.inheritable: Inheritable set passed across exec.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.shares
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.shares: CPU shares (relative weight).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.intelRdt.l3CacheSchema
observations: oci-config-json.linux.intelRdt.l3CacheSchema: Intel RDT L3 cache schema (e.g. "L3:0=ff;1=ff").

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.readonlyPaths
observations: oci-config-json.linux.readonlyPaths: Paths remounted read-only in container.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.oom_score
observations: containerd-toml.oom_score: OOM score adjustment for the containerd daemon process itself.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.Entrypoint
observations: oci-image-config.config.Entrypoint: Default entrypoint. Replaceable with `--entrypoint`.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.StopSignal
observations: oci-image-config.config.StopSignal: Default kill signal on `docker stop`. Format: SIGNAME or SIGRTMIN+N.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.noNewPrivileges
observations: oci-config-json.process.noNewPrivileges: Sets no_new_privs bit; setuid binaries can't gain caps.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.devices
observations: oci-config-json.linux.devices: Devices made available in the container. type: c|b|u|p. Plus default devices /dev/{null,zero,full,random,urandom,tty}.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.cpus
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.cpus: cpuset.cpus (e.g. "0-3").

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.temp
observations: containerd-toml.temp: Temp dir; defaults to OS temp.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.registry.config_path
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.config_path: Per-registry hosts.toml directory. e.g. /etc/containerd/certs.d/<host>/hosts.toml. The modern way to configure mirrors / TLS / auth (vs deprecated registry.mirrors).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.image_decryption.key_model
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".image_decryption.key_model: Image decryption key model. `node` = key on the node. Used with encrypted images.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.force
observations: runc-cli-flag.--force, -f: runc-delete only. SIGKILL the container before deleting.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.www-authenticate
observations: oci-distribution-header.WWW-Authenticate: In 401 response. Tells client where to fetch a bearer token from.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.oomScoreAdj
observations: oci-config-json.process.oomScoreAdj: Per-process OOM-score adjustment.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.root.path
observations: oci-config-json.root.path: Path to the rootfs dir relative to the bundle.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.pids.limit
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.pids.limit: pids.max — number of tasks in the cgroup. Defense vs fork bombs.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.hostname
observations: oci-config-json.hostname: Container hostname (UTS namespace).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cgroup.path
observations: containerd-toml.cgroup.path: Containerd's own cgroup path.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.sandbox_image
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".pinned_images.sandbox: Pause image for pod sandboxes. Pinned: never garbage-collected.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.console-socket
observations: runc-cli-flag.--console-socket: AF_UNIX socket to receive pty master fd via SCM_RIGHTS. Required if process.terminal=true.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.range
observations: oci-distribution-header.Range: Partial blob retrieval (resume-pull pattern).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.user.additionalGids
observations: oci-config-json.process.user.additionalGids: Supplementary GIDs.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.seccomp.syscalls
observations: oci-config-json.linux.seccomp.syscalls: Per-syscall rules. names[] of syscalls; action; optional args[] of {index, value, op} for parameter matching.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.rootfsPropagation
observations: oci-config-json.linux.rootfsPropagation: Mount-propagation mode for the root filesystem.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.domainname
observations: oci-config-json.domainname: Container NIS domain.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.required_plugins
observations: containerd-toml.required_plugins: Plugin IDs whose load failure aborts containerd startup. Use to fail fast on critical plugins.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.ttrpc.address
observations: containerd-toml.ttrpc.address: ttrpc socket (low-overhead grpc-like protocol used between containerd and shims).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.runtimes.runtime_type
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime".containerd.runtimes.<name>.runtime_type: Shim runtime type. Common values: io.containerd.runc.v2 (default), io.containerd.runsc.v1 (gVisor), io.containerd.kata.v2 (Kata Containers).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.architecture
observations: oci-image-config.architecture: Required. CPU arch: amd64, arm64, arm, s390x, ppc64le, riscv64, mips64le.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.Cmd
observations: oci-image-config.config.Cmd: Default args to entrypoint. If no entrypoint, first element is the executable.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.authorization
observations: oci-distribution-header.Authorization: `Basic <b64>` for basic auth or `Bearer <token>` for token auth.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.oci-subject
observations: oci-distribution-header.OCI-Subject: Returned on PUT manifest with subject — confirms server processed the referrers relationship.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.rlimits
observations: oci-config-json.process.rlimits: setrlimit calls before exec. Types: RLIMIT_CPU, RLIMIT_NOFILE, RLIMIT_NPROC, RLIMIT_AS, RLIMIT_DATA, etc.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.namespaces
observations: oci-config-json.linux.namespaces: Namespaces the container enters. type: pid|network|mount|ipc|uts|user|cgroup|time. With path, joins the existing namespace; without, creates a new one. Duplicate types = error.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.blockIO.weight
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.blockIO.weight: Block-IO weight.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.seccomp.defaultAction
observations: oci-config-json.linux.seccomp.defaultAction: Default action for syscalls not matched by syscalls[]. Values: SCMP_ACT_KILL, SCMP_ACT_KILL_PROCESS, SCMP_ACT_TRAP, SCMP_ACT_ERRNO, SCMP_ACT_TRACE, SCMP_ACT_ALLOW, SCMP_ACT_LOG, SCMP_ACT_NOTIFY.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.version
observations: containerd-toml.version: Config schema version. Required first line. v3 introduced in containerd 2.0; v2 still supported and auto-converted.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.timeouts
observations: containerd-toml.timeouts: Per-operation timeouts. Common keys: io.containerd.timeout.shim.cleanup, io.containerd.timeout.shim.load, io.containerd.timeout.shim.shutdown, io.containerd.timeout.task.state.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.rootfs.type
observations: oci-image-config.rootfs.type: Currently always "layers".

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.selinuxLabel
observations: oci-config-json.process.selinuxLabel: SELinux label.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.seccomp.architectures
observations: oci-config-json.linux.seccomp.architectures: Architectures the seccomp filter applies to (e.g. SCMP_ARCH_X86_64, SCMP_ARCH_X86, SCMP_ARCH_AARCH64).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.max_concurrent_downloads
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".max_concurrent_downloads: Max parallel layer downloads in CRI image pulls.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.User
observations: oci-image-config.config.User: Default user for `docker run`. Forms: user, uid, user:group, uid:gid.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.history
observations: oci-image-config.history: Per-layer build history. `docker history` reads this.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.capabilities.effective
observations: oci-config-json.process.capabilities.effective: Capabilities the process actively has at start.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.capabilities.permitted
observations: oci-config-json.process.capabilities.permitted: Capabilities the process is allowed to acquire.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.maskedPaths
observations: oci-config-json.linux.maskedPaths: Paths bind-mounted /dev/null in container. Hides sensitive proc/sys entries.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.hooks.createContainer
observations: oci-config-json.hooks.createContainer: Container-namespace hooks before pivot_root.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.os.features
observations: oci-image-config.os.features: Mandatory OS features (e.g. "win32k" on Windows).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.WorkingDir
observations: oci-image-config.config.WorkingDir: Default cwd.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.location
observations: oci-distribution-header.Location: Returned by `POST /v2/<name>/blobs/uploads/`. Subsequent PATCHes go to this URL.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.user.umask
observations: oci-config-json.process.user.umask: File mode creation mask for the user-specified process.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.memory.swap
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.memory.swap: Memory + swap.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.plugin_dir
observations: containerd-toml.plugin_dir: Plugin discovery directory.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.grpc.max_send_message_size
observations: containerd-toml.grpc.max_send_message_size: Max grpc send message size.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.runtimes.options.BinaryName
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime".containerd.runtimes.<name>.options.BinaryName: Path to the runtime binary (e.g. /usr/local/bin/crun for crun).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.variant
observations: oci-image-config.variant: Arch variant (e.g. "v7" for armv7).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.Volumes
observations: oci-image-config.config.Volumes: Paths the image declares as anonymous volumes.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.no-pivot
observations: runc-cli-flag.--no-pivot: Use chroot+chdir instead of pivot_root. Discouraged: 'may be unsafe from a security standpoint'.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.no-new-keyring
observations: runc-cli-flag.--no-new-keyring: Don't create new session keyring; container inherits caller's.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.apparmorProfile
observations: oci-config-json.process.apparmorProfile: AppArmor profile name.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.mounts
observations: oci-config-json.mounts: Filesystem mounts. Default Linux: /proc, /sys, /dev/pts, /dev/shm, /dev/mqueue.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.mountLabel
observations: oci-config-json.linux.mountLabel: SELinux mount label.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.sysctl
observations: oci-config-json.linux.sysctl: Namespaced sysctls applied inside the container (e.g. net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.annotations
observations: oci-config-json.annotations: Arbitrary key/value annotations attached to the container; surfaced via `runc state`.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.grpc.address
observations: containerd-toml.grpc.address: Unix socket grpc API listens on.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.use_local_image_pull
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".use_local_image_pull: v2.1+: use local pull mode instead of Transfer Service. Auto-set true if conflicting options (DiscardUnpackedLayers, Registry.Mirrors, etc.) are present.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.created
observations: oci-image-config.created: Timestamp the image was built.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.author
observations: oci-image-config.author: Person/entity that built the image.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.detach
observations: runc-cli-flag.--detach, -d: Detach from container's process. run/exec.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.docker-distribution-api-version
observations: oci-distribution-header.Docker-Distribution-API-Version: Registry advertises its API version (sniff endpoint).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.content-length
observations: oci-distribution-header.Content-Length: Required on monolithic upload PUT.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.terminal
observations: oci-config-json.process.terminal: If true, runtime allocates a pseudo-TTY pair and delivers the master fd via --console-socket.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.user.gid
observations: oci-config-json.process.user.gid: Primary group ID.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.args
observations: oci-config-json.process.args: Command line of the user-specified process. NOT applied at create time — only at start.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.root.readonly
observations: oci-config-json.root.readonly: Mount rootfs read-only.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.quota
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.quota: CFS quota.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.hugepageLimits
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.hugepageLimits: Hugetlb limits. Page sizes: "2MB", "1GB".

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.image_pull_progress_timeout
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".image_pull_progress_timeout: Abort an image pull if no progress for this long. Set higher for big images on slow links.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.config.ArgsEscaped
observations: oci-image-config.config.ArgsEscaped: DEPRECATED. Windows-only legacy flag indicating Entrypoint/Cmd are pre-escaped strings.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.content-range
observations: oci-distribution-header.Content-Range: Used in chunked-upload PATCH requests: `Content-Range: <START>-<END>`.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-distribution-header.accept
observations: oci-distribution-header.Accept: Used by clients to negotiate manifest format. Comma-separated mediatypes; common: `application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json,application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json`.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.process.capabilities.ambient
observations: oci-config-json.process.capabilities.ambient: Ambient set — preserved across exec without setuid.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.hooks.poststart
observations: oci-config-json.hooks.poststart: Hooks after user process exec.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.root
observations: containerd-toml.root: Persistent state root (content store, snapshotters, metadata).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.grpc.tcp_tls_cert
observations: containerd-toml.grpc.tcp_tls_cert: TLS cert for grpc TCP listener.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.default_runtime_name
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime".containerd.default_runtime_name (v3) | plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".containerd.default_runtime_name (v2): Default runtime class name for new pods.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.snapshotter.overlayfs.root_path
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.snapshotter.v1.overlayfs".root_path: Root path for overlayfs snapshotter. Override to put image layers on a separate disk.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-image-config.os
observations: oci-image-config.os: Required. Operating system: linux, windows, darwin, freebsd.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.ignore-paused
observations: runc-cli-flag.--ignore-paused: runc-exec only. Allow exec in a paused container (must resume for exec to complete).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.uidMappings
observations: oci-config-json.linux.uidMappings: User namespace UID maps. Each: containerID, hostID, size.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.memory.limit
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.memory.limit: Hard memory limit (cgroup memory.limit_in_bytes / memory.max).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.memory.reservation
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.memory.reservation: Memory soft limit.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.period
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.period: CFS period.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.mems
observations: oci-config-json.linux.resources.cpu.mems: cpuset.mems (NUMA node list).

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.runtimes.options.SystemdCgroup
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime".containerd.runtimes.runc.options.SystemdCgroup: Use systemd cgroup driver instead of cgroupfs. RECOMMENDED on systemd hosts ("single-writer" rule). Must match KubeletConfiguration.cgroupDriver.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.cni.bin_dir
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime".cni.bin_dir: Directory of CNI plugin binaries.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.registry.mirrors
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".registry.mirrors.<host>.endpoint: DEPRECATED — use registry.config_path. Per-host registry mirror endpoints.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.bundle
observations: runc-cli-flag.--bundle, -b: Path to OCI bundle directory. Used by create/run/spec.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.pid-file
observations: runc-cli-flag.--pid-file: Write initial container process pid to this file.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.runc-cli-flag.keep
observations: runc-cli-flag.--keep: runc-run only. Keep state directory and cgroup after container exits. Manual `runc delete` required.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.oci-config-json.hooks.startContainer
observations: oci-config-json.hooks.startContainer: Container-namespace hooks immediately before user process exec.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.grpc.tcp_tls_key
observations: containerd-toml.grpc.tcp_tls_key: TLS key for grpc TCP listener.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.snapshotter
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.images".snapshotter (v3) | plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".containerd.snapshotter (v2): Snapshotter used for CRI images.

name: docker.runtime.cfg.containerd-toml.cri.cni.conf_dir
observations: containerd-toml.plugins."io.containerd.cri.v1.runtime".cni.conf_dir: Directory of CNI conf files.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.gateway
observations: network-create-flag.--gateway: Gateway IP for each subnet.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.gateway-mode-ipv4
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.gateway_mode_ipv4: IPv4 gateway mode. `isolated` = no MASQUERADE, no port-publish DNAT. See `docker-docs-network-firewall`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.connect-ip
observations: network-create-flag.docker network connect --ip: Pin static IPv4 on the new endpoint. Network must have --subnet.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.connect-link
observations: network-create-flag.docker network connect --link: Add legacy --link entries (default-bridge only). Otherwise use embedded DNS.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.default-address-pools
observations: daemon.json-network.default-address-pools: IP pool space for new user-defined networks. Configure to avoid colliding on-prem subnets.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.fixed-cidr-v6
observations: daemon.json-network.fixed-cidr-v6: IPv6 subnet for default bridge.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.host-gateway-ip
observations: daemon.json-network.host-gateway-ip: Resolves `host-gateway` token in `--add-host=host:host-gateway`. Lets containers reach the host without baking 172.x.0.1.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.enable-icc
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.enable_icc: Enable inter-container communication on this bridge. Daemon-wide alias: --icc.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.gateway-mode-ipv6
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.gateway_mode_ipv6: IPv6 gateway mode counterpart.

name: docker.networking.cfg.ipvlan-driver-opt.kernel-min-version
observations: ipvlan-driver-opt.kernel >= 4.2 (recommended): IPvlan present in earlier kernels but buggy. Verify with `uname -r`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.expose-vs-publish
observations: port-publish-syntax.EXPOSE vs --publish: EXPOSE in Dockerfile is metadata only — doesn't actually publish. -P consumes EXPOSE entries; -p ignores them. Common confusion.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.publish-on-default-bridge
observations: port-publish-syntax.--publish required for outside-the-bridge access: Same-network containers reach each other on all ports without -p; -p is needed only for outside-the-bridge clients (host or external).

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.userland-proxy
observations: daemon.json-network.userland-proxy: Use docker-proxy for hairpin/loopback traffic.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.dns-opts
observations: daemon.json-network.dns-opts: resolv.conf options (e.g. `["ndots:1","timeout:2"]`). Critical for k8s-style cluster DNS perf.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.driver
observations: network-create-flag.-d, --driver: Network driver. Plugin names allowed for third-party drivers.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.subnet
observations: network-create-flag.--subnet: IPv4/IPv6 subnet. Repeatable for v4+v6.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.opt
observations: network-create-flag.-o, --opt: Driver-specific option. Repeatable. Keys depend on driver — see bridge-driver-opt / overlay-driver-opt / ipvlan-driver-opt / macvlan-driver-opt scopes.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.attachable
observations: network-create-flag.--attachable: Overlay-specific. Allow standalone containers to attach (otherwise only Swarm services can).

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.config-only
observations: network-create-flag.--config-only: Create a config-only network (template; not directly usable).

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.publish-mode-vip-vs-dnsrr
observations: network-create-flag.--ingress (publish-mode VIP): Ingress overlay uses VIP-based endpoint mode by default; for >256 IPs use dnsrr endpoint mode + external LB. Documented as a swarm tradeoff in `docker-cli-network-create`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.enable-ip-masquerade
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.enable_ip_masquerade: Enable SNAT/MASQUERADE for outbound container traffic. Daemon-wide alias: --ip-masq.

name: docker.networking.cfg.ipvlan-driver-opt.mode
observations: ipvlan-driver-opt.ipvlan_mode: IPvlan operating mode. l2 = container interfaces sit on parent's L2; l3/l3s = host routes between subnets.

name: docker.networking.cfg.macvlan-driver-opt.mode
observations: macvlan-driver-opt.macvlan_mode: Macvlan mode. bridge = default; private = no inter-container; vepa = reflective relay required upstream; passthru = single MAC per parent (passthrough).

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.host-ip-host-port-container-port
observations: port-publish-syntax.host-ip:host-port:container-port: `-p 127.0.0.1:8080:80` — bind only to 127.0.0.1.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.host-port-range
observations: port-publish-syntax.host-range:container-port: `-p 8000-9000:5000` — bind container's 5000 to a randomly available host port between 8000 and 9000.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.dns
observations: daemon.json-network.dns: Default DNS servers for containers. Per-container override: `--dns`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.ip-range
observations: network-create-flag.--ip-range: Sub-range of --subnet for auto-assignment. Static-pin IPs (--ip on `network connect`) can still be outside the range.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.attach-host-network
observations: network-create-flag.<host-network has no opts>: Host driver doesn't accept any --opt — it's just a marker. Documented in `docker-docs-network-host`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.run-network
observations: network-create-flag.docker run --network <name>: Per-run override of the network a container attaches to. `host`, `none`, `container:<id>`, `<name>`. Repeatable to attach to multiple networks at create.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.inhibit-ipv4
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.inhibit_ipv4: Skip assigning an IP address to the bridge itself (advanced; for setups doing custom routing).

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.host-ipv4
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.host_ipv4: Source NAT address (override of host's selected interface). See packet-filtering doc.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.ip-masq
observations: daemon.json-network.ip-masq: MASQUERADE on default bridge. Bridge-driver alias of `com.docker.network.bridge.enable_ip_masquerade`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.bridge-default-driver
observations: bridge-driver-opt.-o (any unspecified): Daemon-wide `default-network-opts.bridge.<key>` provides defaults applied to every newly-created bridge network — use to set a global MTU or default ICC mode.

name: docker.networking.cfg.macvlan-driver-opt.kernel-min-version
observations: macvlan-driver-opt.kernel >= 3.9 (4.0+ recommended): Older kernels lack stable macvlan driver.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.ip-forward-no-drop
observations: daemon.json-network.ip-forward-no-drop: Don't set FORWARD chain default policy to DROP when enabling IP forwarding. Set true if you want the host to also act as a router.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.internal
observations: network-create-flag.--internal: Restrict external access. No NAT/MASQUERADE; cluster-internal only.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.bridge-name
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.name: Linux bridge interface name to create.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.trusted-host-interfaces
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.trusted_host_interfaces: Override which host interfaces this bridge implicitly trusts for inbound traffic.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.disable-icc-via-iptables
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.disable_iptables_icc: Block inter-container communication via iptables FILTER rules instead of relying on Linux bridge filtering.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.proto-suffix
observations: port-publish-syntax.<port>/proto: Append `/udp` or `/sctp` to specify non-TCP protocols. e.g. `-p 53:53/udp`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.publish-all-flag
observations: port-publish-syntax.-P, --publish-all: Auto-publish every EXPOSE'd port to a random ephemeral host port.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.userland-proxy-path
observations: daemon.json-network.userland-proxy-path: Path to the docker-proxy binary if shipping a custom build.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.ipam-driver
observations: network-create-flag.--ipam-driver: IP-address-management driver. `default` is built-in; pluggable for vendor IPAM.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.ipam-opt
observations: network-create-flag.--ipam-opt: IPAM driver-specific options.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.network-alias
observations: network-create-flag.docker run --network-alias: DNS aliases for the container on user-defined bridges/overlays. Repeatable. Equivalent to network-create's `--alias`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.connect-alias
observations: network-create-flag.docker network connect --alias: Same as --network-alias but applied to a running container's new endpoint.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.subnet-default-blocksize
observations: overlay-driver-opt.--subnet (recommended /24 for swarm services): Per docs, /24 is the recommended block for VIP-mode swarm services. >256 IPs requires dnsrr endpoint mode + external LB.

name: docker.networking.cfg.ipvlan-driver-opt.no-port-publish
observations: ipvlan-driver-opt.port-publish unsupported in L2: L2 mode containers get directly-routable IPs; `-p`/--publish has no effect because there's no DNAT layer.

name: docker.networking.cfg.macvlan-driver-opt.cloud-restriction
observations: macvlan-driver-opt.cloud-provider unsupported (typical): Most cloud NICs block macvlan because they limit MAC count per port. Need physical access to enable.

name: docker.networking.cfg.macvlan-driver-opt.no-iptables
observations: macvlan-driver-opt.iptables NOT created: Same as ipvlan: no iptables rules created for macvlan networking.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.host-port-container-port
observations: port-publish-syntax.host-port:container-port: Form: `-p 8080:80`. Bind container port 80 to host's 8080 on all interfaces.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.colon-container-port
observations: port-publish-syntax.:container-port: `-p :80` — random ephemeral host port. Equivalent to a single -P entry for one port.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.repeat-flag
observations: port-publish-syntax.-p (repeatable): `-p` can appear multiple times to publish multiple ports.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.iptables
observations: daemon.json-network.iptables: Daemon-managed iptables rules. Disabling = no DNAT for `-p`. Per `docker-docs-network-firewall`, you cannot completely prevent Docker from creating SOME firewall rules.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.run-link-local-ip
observations: network-create-flag.docker run --link-local-ip: Per-container link-local IPv4/IPv6 addresses.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.default-bridge
