observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.default_bridge: Marker option set on the auto-created default bridge — surfaced in `docker network inspect`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.driver-mtu
observations: overlay-driver-opt.com.docker.network.driver.mtu: Overlay MTU. The 50-byte budget covers VXLAN+UDP+IP headers.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.driver-mtu
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.driver.mtu: MTU on this network's interfaces. Lower (1450) when behind GRE/IPsec/VXLAN. Daemon-wide alias: --mtu.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.host-ipv6
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.host_ipv6: Source NAT address (IPv6).

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.aux-address
observations: network-create-flag.--aux-address: Reserve specific IPs (e.g. existing routers in a macvlan subnet). e.g. `--aux-address my-router=192.168.32.129`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.ingress
observations: network-create-flag.--ingress: Create the swarm routing-mesh ingress network. Only one ingress per swarm.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.run-publish-all
observations: network-create-flag.docker run -P, --publish-all: Auto-publish every EXPOSE'd port to a random ephemeral host port.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.swarm-control-port
observations: overlay-driver-opt.swarm control plane port: `docker swarm join --listen-addr` configurable. Required between hosts.

name: docker.networking.cfg.ipvlan-driver-opt.l2-host-isolation
observations: ipvlan-driver-opt.l2 host-side restriction: Containers on an ipvlan L2 network CAN'T ping the parent host on the same parent (kernel filter for additional isolation).

name: docker.networking.cfg.macvlan-driver-opt.host-comm-restriction
observations: macvlan-driver-opt.container-to-host blocked: Linux kernel restriction: macvlan containers can't talk to the host directly. Workaround: also attach a bridge network, OR create a host-side macvlan iface in the same subnet.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.bip
observations: daemon.json-network.bip: Default-bridge IPv4 (with prefix). Pin to avoid VPN-subnet collisions.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.mtu
observations: daemon.json-network.mtu: Default-bridge MTU. Lower for tunnel-behind hosts.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.ip-forward
observations: daemon.json-network.ip-forward: Enable kernel `net.ipv4.ip_forward`. Disabling kills outbound bridge traffic.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.connect-ip6
observations: network-create-flag.docker network connect --ip6: Pin static IPv6 on the new endpoint.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.run-add-host
observations: network-create-flag.docker run --add-host: Add /etc/hosts entries. Special token `host-gateway` resolves to the host's IP (per daemon `host-gateway-ip`).

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.host-binding-ipv4
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.bridge.host_binding_ipv4: Default host address for `-p containerPort` (no host IP given). Set to `127.0.0.1` to default-bind only loopback. Daemon-wide alias: --ip.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.encrypted
observations: overlay-driver-opt.encrypted: Enable IPsec encryption at the VXLAN layer. Non-trivial CPU cost. NOT supported for Windows containers.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.vxlan-data-port
observations: overlay-driver-opt.VXLAN data-plane port: `docker swarm init --data-path-addr/--data-path-port` configurable. Required UDP between hosts.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.encrypted-windows-warning
observations: overlay-driver-opt.encrypted (Windows containers): Swarm doesn't error when Windows hosts attach to encrypted overlays, but networking for Windows containers becomes broken. Use unencrypted overlays for Windows.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.firewall-backend
observations: daemon.json-network.firewall-backend: Pick nftables on modern systems where iptables is a compat wrapper.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.ipv4
observations: network-create-flag.--ipv4: Enable IPv4 (default true). Set false + --ipv6 for IPv6-only network.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.disconnect-force
observations: network-create-flag.docker network disconnect -f, --force: Force-disconnect even if container uses the network as its default.

name: docker.networking.cfg.bridge-driver-opt.container-iface-prefix
observations: bridge-driver-opt.com.docker.network.container_iface_prefix: Naming prefix for the container-side veth (eth0, eth1, …).

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.vxlanid-list
observations: overlay-driver-opt.com.docker.network.driver.overlay.vxlanid_list: Pin VXLAN VNI(s). Useful for interoperability with non-Docker VXLAN endpoints.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.gossip-tcp
observations: overlay-driver-opt.swarm gossip port (tcp): NOT configurable. Required TCP between hosts.

name: docker.networking.cfg.ipvlan-driver-opt.l3-vlan-trunk
observations: ipvlan-driver-opt.802.1Q trunk via parent.<vid>: Specify `parent=eth0.<vid>` to attach to an 802.1Q VLAN sub-interface; Docker creates the sub-interface on the fly.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.host-ip-colon-colon-container-port
observations: port-publish-syntax.host-ip::container-port: `-p 127.0.0.1::5000` — bind to a dynamic host port on a specific host IP.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.docker-port
observations: port-publish-syntax.docker port <container> [<port>[/<proto>]]: Read back live host bindings. Required for -P (random) ports.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.ip6tables
observations: daemon.json-network.ip6tables: Daemon-managed ip6tables rules. Disabling per docs may break IPv6 packet filtering and port mapping.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.run-mac-address
observations: network-create-flag.docker run --mac-address: Pin a specific MAC for the container's endpoint.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.gossip-udp
observations: overlay-driver-opt.swarm gossip port (udp): NOT configurable. Required UDP between hosts.

name: docker.networking.cfg.ipvlan-driver-opt.flag
observations: ipvlan-driver-opt.ipvlan_flag: Sub-mode flag. private = no inter-container traffic via parent; vepa = traffic goes out parent and back via reflective relay.

name: docker.networking.cfg.ipvlan-driver-opt.parent
observations: ipvlan-driver-opt.parent: Host interface or sub-interface (e.g. eth0, eth0.10). Sub-interfaces with a `.` are created on the fly.

name: docker.networking.cfg.macvlan-driver-opt.rootless-unsupported
observations: macvlan-driver-opt.rootless mode: NOT supported: Macvlan needs CAP_NET_ADMIN on the parent — incompatible with rootless dockerd.

name: docker.networking.cfg.port-publish-syntax.port-conflict
observations: port-publish-syntax.port-allocated error: `Bind for 0.0.0.0:80 failed: port is already allocated`. Cause: another process or container holds the port. Diagnose: `ss -tlnp`, `docker ps --filter publish=80`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.fixed-cidr
observations: daemon.json-network.fixed-cidr: IPv4 subnet for default-bridge container IP allocation (must be within `bip`).

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.scope
observations: network-create-flag.--scope: Network scope. bridge defaults local; overlay defaults swarm.

name: docker.networking.cfg.ipvlan-driver-opt.no-iptables
observations: ipvlan-driver-opt.iptables NOT created: Per docker-docs-network-firewall: 'No rules are created for ipvlan, macvlan or host networking.' Containers handle their own routing.

name: docker.networking.cfg.macvlan-driver-opt.parent
observations: macvlan-driver-opt.parent: Host interface (e.g. eth0). For 802.1Q trunk, use `parent=eth0.<vid>` — Docker creates the sub-interface.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.ipv6
observations: network-create-flag.--ipv6: Enable IPv6 on this network.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.config-from
observations: network-create-flag.--config-from: Copy IPAM/options from a config-only network template.

name: docker.networking.cfg.network-create-flag.label
observations: network-create-flag.--label: Network metadata. Surfaced in `docker network ls --filter label=`.

name: docker.networking.cfg.overlay-driver-opt.attachable
observations: overlay-driver-opt.--attachable (network-create flag, but overlay-specific semantics): Required to attach standalone containers to an overlay (Swarm services attach by default).

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.bridge
observations: daemon.json-network.bridge: Network bridge name for the default bridge network. Re-keyed under `daemon.json-network` to avoid PK collision with engine's `daemon.json` scope; engine catalogs the daemon-wide config; here we attach the networking-specific semantic.

name: docker.networking.cfg.daemon.json-network.dns-search
observations: daemon.json-network.dns-search: Default DNS search domains.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.depends_on
observations: services.<name>.depends_on: Service dependencies. List form = bare order. Map form supports `condition: service_started|service_healthy|service_completed_successfully` + `restart: bool`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cgroup_parent
observations: services.<name>.cgroup_parent: Parent cgroup path.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.ipc
observations: services.<name>.ipc: IPC mode. host|container:<id>|service:<name>|shareable|none.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.stop_grace_period
observations: services.<name>.stop_grace_period: Grace before SIGKILL on stop.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.mac_address
observations: services.<name>.mac_address: Container MAC.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.mem_reservation
observations: services.<name>.mem_reservation: Soft memory limit.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpu_period
observations: services.<name>.cpu_period: CFS period.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.update_config.failure_action
observations: services.<name>.deploy.update_config.failure_action: Behavior on update failure.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.update_config.order
observations: services.<name>.deploy.update_config.order: Update order: start-first replaces gracefully (recommended); stop-first stops the old replica before starting the new one.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.name
observations: networks.<name>.name: Override the network's actual name (defeats project prefix).

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.driver
observations: volumes.<name>.driver: Volume driver. local|nfs|<plugin>.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.long-mount-form-readonly
observations: volumes.<name>.services.<name>.volumes[].read_only: Read-only mount.

name: docker.compose.cfg.configs.environment
observations: configs.<name>.environment: Take config content from this env var. Newer alternative to `content`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.environment
observations: services.<name>.environment: Container env vars. Bare `KEY` (no value) inherits from caller's env.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.working_dir
observations: services.<name>.working_dir: Working dir inside the container.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.restart
observations: services.<name>.restart: Compose-managed restart policy. Distinct from `deploy.restart_policy` (Swarm-only).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.security_opt
observations: services.<name>.security_opt: Security options. e.g. `seccomp=…`, `apparmor=…`, `label=…`, `no-new-privileges:true`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.dns
observations: services.<name>.dns: Per-container DNS server(s).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpu_count
observations: services.<name>.cpu_count: Windows-only CPU count.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.dockerfile
observations: services.<name>.build.dockerfile: Path to Dockerfile relative to context.

name: docker.compose.cfg.top-level.include
observations: top-level.include: Include other Compose files as sub-projects.

name: docker.compose.cfg.develop-watch.action
observations: develop.watch.action: Action on change. rebuild = full image rebuild; sync = file copy; restart = container restart; sync+exec = sync then run a command.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.command
observations: services.<name>.command: Override the image's default CMD. List form preferred (exec form, no shell wrapping).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cap_drop
observations: services.<name>.cap_drop: Drop capabilities. cap_drop=[ALL] + selective cap_add = least-privilege baseline.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cgroupns_mode
observations: services.<name>.cgroup: Cgroup namespace mode (alias of docker run --cgroupns).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.mem_limit
observations: services.<name>.mem_limit: Hard memory limit. Mirror of `--memory`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.external_links
observations: services.<name>.external_links: Link to containers outside the project (legacy).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.network_mode
observations: services.<name>.network_mode: Special network modes: host|none|service:<name>|container:<id>. Mutually exclusive with `networks`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.isolation
observations: services.<name>.build.isolation: Build isolation tech (Windows: process|hyperv).

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.restart_policy.delay
observations: services.<name>.deploy.restart_policy.delay: Wait before restart attempt.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.ipam.config.ip_range
observations: networks.<name>.ipam.config[].ip_range: Allocation range within subnet.

name: docker.compose.cfg.configs.file
observations: configs.<name>.file: Local file content. Mutually exclusive with `external` and `content`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.secrets.external
observations: secrets.<name>.external: Reference platform-managed secret.

name: docker.compose.cfg.top-level.configs
observations: top-level.configs: All configs.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.deploy
observations: services.<name>.deploy: Swarm-related metadata. See services.<name>.deploy scope.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.profiles
observations: services.<name>.profiles: Activation profiles. Service is ignored unless one of these profiles is active OR the service is targeted explicitly.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.label_file
observations: services.<name>.label_file: File(s) of labels (one `KEY=VAL` per line).

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.context
observations: services.<name>.build.context: Build context. Local dir or git URL `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git#<ref>:<subdir>`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.dockerfile_inline
observations: services.<name>.build.dockerfile_inline: Inline Dockerfile content. Useful for one-off / generated builds.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.cache_to
observations: services.<name>.build.cache_to: Push cache to these targets.

name: docker.compose.cfg.healthcheck.start_period
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck.start_period: Initial wait before counting failures.

name: docker.compose.cfg.depends_on.condition
observations: services.<name>.depends_on.<svc>.condition: When the dependency is satisfied.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.name
observations: volumes.<name>.name: Override actual volume name.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.labels
observations: volumes.<name>.labels: Labels.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.short-form
observations: volumes.<name>.<empty> declaration ({}): `vol-name: {}` is the minimum needed to declare a volume; Compose creates it on `up` with default driver.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.logging
observations: services.<name>.logging: Per-service log driver + options. e.g. `{driver: json-file, options: {max-size: 10m, max-file: 3}}`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpuset
observations: services.<name>.cpuset: CPUs to allow execution on (e.g. `0-3`).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.pids_limit
observations: services.<name>.pids_limit: Pids cgroup limit.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.mode
observations: services.<name>.deploy.mode: Replication strategy. global = one per node.

name: docker.compose.cfg.top-level.services
observations: top-level.services: All services in the project.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.privileged
observations: services.<name>.privileged: Run with extended host privileges. Avoid; use targeted cap_add + devices instead.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.shm_size
observations: services.<name>.shm_size: /dev/shm size.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.platform
observations: services.<name>.platform: Force platform on multi-arch images.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.devices
observations: services.<name>.devices: Pass host devices through.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.ssh
observations: services.<name>.build.ssh: SSH agents/keys for build (consumed by `RUN --mount=type=ssh`). `default` uses the host SSH agent.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.extra_hosts
observations: services.<name>.build.extra_hosts: /etc/hosts entries during build.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.shm_size
observations: services.<name>.build.shm_size: /dev/shm size during build.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.endpoint_mode
observations: services.<name>.deploy.endpoint_mode: Service-discovery method. vip = single VIP front-end (Swarm routing). dnsrr = DNS returns list of replicas' IPs (client picks).

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.placement.constraints
observations: services.<name>.deploy.placement.constraints: Required node attributes. e.g. `node.role==manager`, `engine.labels.zone==eu-west-1`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.resources.limits.pids
observations: services.<name>.deploy.resources.limits.pids: Pids cgroup limit.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.resources.reservations.memory
observations: services.<name>.deploy.resources.reservations.memory: Memory reservation.

name: docker.compose.cfg.healthcheck.timeout
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck.timeout: Max probe time.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.driver_opts
observations: volumes.<name>.driver_opts: Driver-specific options. NFS example: `{type: nfs, device: ":/path", o: "addr=..."}`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.external
observations: volumes.<name>.external: Reference existing volume. Compose neither creates nor removes.

name: docker.compose.cfg.develop-watch.exec.user
observations: develop.watch.exec.{user|privileged|working_dir|environment}: Per-exec context: `user`, `privileged`, `working_dir`, `environment`. Defaults inherit from the service's main command.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpus
observations: services.<name>.cpus: CPU quota expressed as fractional cores.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.volumes_from
observations: services.<name>.volumes_from: Mount volumes from another container/service. Form: `<svc>[:ro|rw]`, `container:<id>[:ro|rw]`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.depends_on.restart
observations: services.<name>.depends_on.<svc>.restart: Restart this service when the dependency is restarted.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.external
observations: networks.<name>.external: Reference an existing network. Compose doesn't create or remove it.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.long-mount-form-type
observations: volumes.<name>.services.<name>.volumes[].type: Long-form mount type.

name: docker.compose.cfg.develop-watch.include
observations: develop.watch.include: Patterns to include. Wildcards must be quoted in YAML to avoid alias-node interpretation.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.volumes
observations: services.<name>.volumes: Mounts. Short form: `<host>:<container>[:opts]` or `<volume-name>:<container>[:opts]`. Long form: `{type, source, target, read_only, bind, volume, tmpfs, consistency}`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.pid
observations: services.<name>.pid: PID namespace mode. host|container:<id>|service:<name>|none.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.oom_kill_disable
observations: services.<name>.oom_kill_disable: Disable OOM-killer for this service. Use with care.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.gpus
observations: services.<name>.gpus: GPU pass-through.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.provider
observations: services.<name>.provider: `{type, options}` — mark service as platform-managed (provider type names like `model`). Compose hands lifecycle to the provider plugin instead of running a container.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.target
observations: services.<name>.build.target: Build a specific stage (multi-stage Dockerfile).

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.additional_contexts
observations: services.<name>.build.additional_contexts: Named build contexts. Forms: `name=path`, `name=docker-image://image`, `name=service:<svc>`, `name=https://git`. Consumed by `COPY --from=<name>`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.placement.preferences
observations: services.<name>.deploy.placement.preferences: Soft placement strategy — spread replicas evenly by node attribute. Currently only `spread`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.resources.reservations.cpus
observations: services.<name>.deploy.resources.reservations.cpus: CPU reservation (Swarm scheduler hint).

name: docker.compose.cfg.depends_on.list-form
observations: services.<name>.depends_on.depends_on (list form): Bare list = each entry treated as `{condition: service_started, restart: false}`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.hostname
observations: services.<name>.hostname: Container hostname (UTS).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.healthcheck
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck: Per-service healthcheck. Override or define one. See services.<name>.healthcheck scope for sub-keys.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.network
observations: services.<name>.build.network: Network mode during build (`default|none|host` or named network).

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.labels
observations: services.<name>.build.labels: Image labels written into the built image.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.placement.max_replicas_per_node
observations: services.<name>.deploy.placement.max_replicas_per_node: Cap replicas per node.

name: docker.compose.cfg.healthcheck.interval
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck.interval: Time between probes.

name: docker.compose.cfg.healthcheck.retries
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck.retries: Failures before marking unhealthy.

name: docker.compose.cfg.healthcheck.test-shell-vs-exec
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck.test-form: `CMD` runs args directly; `CMD-SHELL` wraps in `/bin/sh -c`. Use CMD for exec, CMD-SHELL for `pg_isready -U $${USER}`-style commands.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.driver_opts
observations: networks.<name>.driver_opts: Driver-specific options. Same shape as `docker network create -o`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.ipam.driver
observations: networks.<name>.ipam.driver: IPAM driver.

name: docker.compose.cfg.secrets.file
observations: secrets.<name>.file: Local file with secret content.

name: docker.compose.cfg.secrets.labels
observations: secrets.<name>.labels: Labels.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.entrypoint
observations: services.<name>.entrypoint: Override image ENTRYPOINT. Setting `entrypoint: []` clears it.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cap_add
observations: services.<name>.cap_add: Add Linux capabilities. e.g. NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.stop_signal
observations: services.<name>.stop_signal: Signal for `docker compose stop`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpu_rt_period
observations: services.<name>.cpu_rt_period: Realtime period.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.annotations
observations: services.<name>.annotations: OCI runtime annotations passed through to the OCI bundle config.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.privileged
observations: services.<name>.build.privileged: Build with privileged mode (extended host privileges during build).

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.restart_policy.max_attempts
observations: services.<name>.deploy.restart_policy.max_attempts: Max restart tries within `window`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.restart_policy.window
observations: services.<name>.deploy.restart_policy.window: Window for evaluating max_attempts.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.driver
observations: networks.<name>.driver: Network driver.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.ipam.config.subnet
observations: networks.<name>.ipam.config[].subnet: Subnet (per ipam.config[] entry).

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.ipam.config.gateway
observations: networks.<name>.ipam.config[].gateway: Gateway address.

name: docker.compose.cfg.secrets.environment
observations: secrets.<name>.environment: Take secret content from env var.

name: docker.compose.cfg.top-level.name
observations: top-level.name: Project name. CLI override: `-p <name>` or env `COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME`. Lowercase letters/digits/dashes/underscores only.

name: docker.compose.cfg.top-level.networks
observations: top-level.networks: All networks. Empty `<name>: {}` declares a default-bridge network.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.expose
observations: services.<name>.expose: EXPOSE-equivalent metadata. Doesn't publish — just signals to other containers what ports are listening.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.tmpfs
observations: services.<name>.tmpfs: Mount tmpfs at given path(s). Optional `:size=…,mode=…` suffix.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.attach
observations: services.<name>.attach: Whether `docker compose up` streams this service's logs. false = silent.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpu_shares
observations: services.<name>.cpu_shares: Relative CPU weight.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.scale
observations: services.<name>.scale: Number of containers (legacy; deploy.replicas preferred).

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.secrets
observations: services.<name>.build.secrets: Secrets visible to the build (consumed by `RUN --mount=type=secret`).

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.resources.limits.memory
observations: services.<name>.deploy.resources.limits.memory: Memory hard cap.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.update_config.delay
observations: services.<name>.deploy.update_config.delay: Delay between updating each batch.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.labels
observations: networks.<name>.labels: Network labels.

name: docker.compose.cfg.configs.content
observations: configs.<name>.content: Inline content. Mutually exclusive with `file` and `external`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.develop-watch.target
observations: develop.watch.target: Container path to sync to (sync action).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.domainname
observations: services.<name>.domainname: NIS domain name.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.userns_mode
observations: services.<name>.userns_mode: Only valid value `host` (disable daemon-wide userns-remap for this service).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.read_only
observations: services.<name>.read_only: Mount root filesystem read-only.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.memswap_limit
observations: services.<name>.memswap_limit: Memory + swap. -1 unlimited.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.oom_score_adj
observations: services.<name>.oom_score_adj: OOM-killer score adjustment.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpu_quota
observations: services.<name>.cpu_quota: CFS quota.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.sysctls
observations: services.<name>.sysctls: Set namespaced sysctls.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.runtime
observations: services.<name>.runtime: OCI runtime (runc, crun, kata, etc.).

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.cache_from
observations: services.<name>.build.cache_from: Pull cache from these refs/types. Forms: `type=registry,ref=<image>`, `type=local,src=<path>`, `type=gha`, etc.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.labels
observations: services.<name>.deploy.labels: Labels on the SERVICE (not its containers — see services.<name>.labels for those).

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.resources.limits.cpus
observations: services.<name>.deploy.resources.limits.cpus: CPU hard cap (cgroup-enforced).

name: docker.compose.cfg.healthcheck.test
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck.test: `["NONE"]`, `["CMD", arg, ...]` (exec), `["CMD-SHELL", "shell"]`. Exit 0 = healthy.

name: docker.compose.cfg.depends_on.cycle-detection
observations: services.<name>.depends_on.cycle detection: Compose errors on circular dependencies. Refactor with healthcheck + retry-in-app instead.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.attachable
observations: networks.<name>.attachable: Overlay-specific. Allow standalone containers to attach.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.ipam.options
observations: networks.<name>.ipam.options: IPAM driver options.

name: docker.compose.cfg.configs.external
observations: configs.<name>.external: Reference platform-managed config. Compose looks it up at runtime.

name: docker.compose.cfg.secrets.name
observations: secrets.<name>.name: Override actual secret name.

name: docker.compose.cfg.top-level.volumes
observations: top-level.volumes: All volumes.

name: docker.compose.cfg.develop-watch.path
observations: develop.watch.path: Source path to monitor. Relative to project dir.

name: docker.compose.cfg.develop-watch.initial_sync
observations: develop.watch.initial_sync: On a new watch session against existing containers, sync files first to bring container content up to date.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.ports
observations: services.<name>.ports: Published ports. Short form: `"8080:80"`, `"127.0.0.1:8080:80/tcp"`. Long form: `{target, published, protocol, mode, host_ip, app_protocol}`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.secrets
observations: services.<name>.secrets: Secrets to mount. Short form = secret name. Long form configures target path + perms.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.args
observations: services.<name>.build.args: Build args (Dockerfile ARG values).

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.platforms
observations: services.<name>.build.platforms: Multi-arch build target platforms (BuildKit + buildx).

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.resources.reservations.devices
observations: services.<name>.deploy.resources.reservations.devices: Device reservations. e.g. `capabilities: [gpu]` for GPU pass-through.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.restart_policy.condition
observations: services.<name>.deploy.restart_policy.condition: When to restart on exit. Swarm-managed; distinct from top-level `restart`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.long-mount-form-source
observations: volumes.<name>.services.<name>.volumes[].source: Volume name (volume) or host path (bind).

name: docker.compose.cfg.configs.name
observations: configs.<name>.name: Override actual config name.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.stdin_open
observations: services.<name>.stdin_open: Keep stdin open. With tty=true mirrors `docker run -it`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.dns_search
observations: services.<name>.dns_search: DNS search domains.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.dns_opt
observations: services.<name>.dns_opt: resolv.conf options.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.ulimits
observations: services.<name>.ulimits: Set ulimits. e.g. `nofile: {soft: 65536, hard: 65536}`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.pull_policy
observations: services.<name>.pull_policy: When to pull. `build` = use build block instead of pulling.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.device_cgroup_rules
observations: services.<name>.device_cgroup_rules: Cgroup device-allowlist rules.

name: docker.compose.cfg.healthcheck.disable
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck.disable: Equivalent to `test: [NONE]` — disable image's HEALTHCHECK.

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.internal
observations: networks.<name>.internal: No external connectivity (no NAT, no ports).

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.priority
observations: networks.<name>.priority (per-service attach): In `services.<name>.networks.<net>.priority` — controls which network is preferred for the default route when multi-attached.

name: docker.compose.cfg.volumes.long-mount-form-target
observations: volumes.<name>.services.<name>.volumes[].target: Container-side mount path.

name: docker.compose.cfg.top-level.secrets
observations: top-level.secrets: All secrets.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.image
observations: services.<name>.image: Image to use for the service. Forms: `<repo>:<tag>`, `<repo>@sha256:<digest>`. With `build`, used as the tag for the built image. Required if no `build` block.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.build
observations: services.<name>.build: Build configuration. String form = build context dir. Object form = full structure (see services.<name>.build scope).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.env_file
observations: services.<name>.env_file: Load env from one or more files (KEY=VAL per line). Object form supports `required: false` and `format: raw` (no interpolation).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.networks
observations: services.<name>.networks: Networks to attach. Map form gives per-network options (aliases, static IPs).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.init
observations: services.<name>.init: Inject docker-init/tini as pid 1.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.tty
observations: services.<name>.tty: Allocate a pseudo-TTY.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpu_rt_runtime
observations: services.<name>.cpu_rt_runtime: Realtime runtime quota.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.configs
observations: services.<name>.configs: Configs to mount. Same shape as secrets.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.links
observations: services.<name>.links: Legacy --link. Default-bridge only; user-defined networks resolve by name without it.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.develop
observations: services.<name>.develop: Development hooks. See develop.watch scope.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.no_cache
observations: services.<name>.build.no_cache: Don't use any cache.

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.tags
observations: services.<name>.build.tags: Additional tags for the built image (in addition to top-level `image`).

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.replicas
observations: services.<name>.deploy.replicas: Number of containers (replicated mode).

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.enable_ipv6
observations: networks.<name>.enable_ipv6: Enable IPv6 on this network.

name: docker.compose.cfg.develop-watch.ignore
observations: develop.watch.ignore: Patterns to skip. Same syntax as .dockerignore. .dockerignore content is implicitly merged in.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.user
observations: services.<name>.user: User to run as: `<uid|name>[:<gid|group>]`.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.labels
observations: services.<name>.labels: Container labels (NOT service labels — those live under `deploy.labels`).

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.extra_hosts
observations: services.<name>.extra_hosts: /etc/hosts entries. Special token `host-gateway` resolves to host.

name: docker.compose.cfg.services.cpu_percent
observations: services.<name>.cpu_percent: Windows-only CPU percent (0..100).

name: docker.compose.cfg.build.pull
observations: services.<name>.build.pull: Always pull base images.

name: docker.compose.cfg.deploy.update_config.parallelism
observations: services.<name>.deploy.update_config.parallelism: Replicas updated simultaneously.

name: docker.compose.cfg.healthcheck.start_interval
observations: services.<name>.healthcheck.start_interval: Probe cadence during start_period.

name: docker.compose.cfg.depends_on.required
observations: services.<name>.depends_on.<svc>.required: If false, missing dependency is silently skipped (rather than erroring).

name: docker.compose.cfg.networks.ipam.config.aux_addresses
observations: networks.<name>.ipam.config[].aux_addresses: Reserved IPs.

name: docker.compose.cfg.configs.labels
observations: configs.<name>.labels: Labels.

name: docker.compose.cfg.top-level.version
observations: top-level.version: DEPRECATED. Compose v2 ignores; left for v1 compat. Don't add to new files.

name: docker.compose.cfg.develop-watch.exec.command
observations: develop.watch.exec.command: sync+exec only. Command to run after sync. Either shell form or exec form.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.icc
observations: daemon.json-security.icc: Inter-container communication on default bridge. `false` enforces network isolation by default — containers must use user-defined networks (which are scoped) for comms.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.userland-proxy
observations: daemon.json-security.userland-proxy: Disabling docker-proxy reduces attack surface (one fewer suid-like helper) at the cost of breaking some hairpin/loopback patterns.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.authorization-plugins
observations: daemon.json-security.authorization-plugins: Authorization plugins (e.g. opa-docker-authz). Daemon refuses ops not allowed by every listed plugin. Useful for gating `docker run --privileged` etc. at the API.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.syscalls.includes
observations: seccomp-profile-json.syscalls[].includes: Apply this rule only if container has these capabilities / runs on these arches / minKernel match. e.g. allow `mount` only if CAP_SYS_ADMIN.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.mount-rules
observations: apparmor-profile-template.mount / umount: Allow specific mount/umount operations. Most container profiles deny mount entirely; default allows umount.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_DISABLE_HOST_LOOPBACK
observations: rootless-env.DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_DISABLE_HOST_LOOPBACK: Disable container access to host loopback (security hardening — containers can't reach host services on 127.0.0.1).

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.syscalls.args
observations: seccomp-profile-json.syscalls[].args: Argument-matching rule. e.g. for socket(domain=…), `{index:0, value:AF_VSOCK, op:SCMP_CMP_EQ}` blocks vsock specifically while allowing other socket calls.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.ptrace
observations: apparmor-profile-template.ptrace: ptrace permission. Default: deny (with selective allows for same-profile).

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.tcp-2376
observations: daemon-tls.port 2376 (TLS): Conventional port for TLS-on TCP. 2375 = unencrypted (refused on modern dockerd).

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.live-restore
observations: daemon.json-security.live-restore: Keep containers running across daemon restart. Security note: an attacker who can crash/restart dockerd can't drop the running container's state.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.cgroup-parent
observations: daemon.json-security.cgroup-parent: Parent cgroup. Pin to `system.slice/docker.slice` for systemd integration; required for full cgroup-delegation in rootless+systemd.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.signal
observations: apparmor-profile-template.signal: Signal-sending policy. e.g. `signal (send) set=(term,kill) peer=other-profile,`.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.daemon-json-tls
observations: daemon-tls.daemon.json `tls`/`tlsverify`/`tlscacert`/`tlscert`/`tlskey`: daemon.json forms equivalent to the CLI flags. Conflict between daemon.json and CLI flags = daemon refuses to start.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_PORT_DRIVER
observations: rootless-env.DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_PORT_DRIVER: Port-forward driver. `builtin` (default) uses RootlessKit's port driver; `slirp4netns` uses slirp4netns's built-in port forwarder.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.dockerd-rootless-setuptool
observations: rootless-env.dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh install: Bootstrap script that creates the user-mode systemd service, configures CLI context `rootless`, and reminds about env vars to export.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.userns-remap
observations: daemon.json-security.userns-remap: `default` (uses dockremap user) or `<user>:<group>`. Daemon still runs as root; container root maps to a non-zero host uid. Mutually exclusive with --privileged, --ipc=host, --net=host, --pid=host containers.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.selinux-enabled
observations: daemon.json-security.selinux-enabled: Enable SELinux container labeling. Requires SELinux running in enforcing/permissive on host.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.default-cgroupns-mode
observations: daemon.json-security.default-cgroupns-mode: Default cgroup-namespace mode. Private hides host's cgroup tree from container.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.default-ulimits
observations: daemon.json-security.default-ulimits: Daemon-wide ulimit defaults. Use to enforce nofile/nproc caps as a hardening baseline.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.exec-opts
observations: daemon.json-security.exec-opts: Includes `native.cgroupdriver=systemd` (single-writer rule for systemd hosts; security relevance: prevents cgroup conflicts that can lead to resource-limit bypass).

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.syscalls
observations: seccomp-profile-json.syscalls: Per-syscall rule list. names[] of syscall names; action; optional args[] for parameter-matching; errnoRet for SCMP_ACT_ERRNO. includes/excludes gate by minKernel/caps.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.tls-flag
observations: daemon-tls.--tls: Enable TLS without client verification. Implied by --tlsverify.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_REPOSITORY_PASSPHRASE
observations: dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_REPOSITORY_PASSPHRASE: Passphrase for the per-repo (tagging) key. Required for non-interactive signing in CI.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_OFFLINE_PASSPHRASE
observations: dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_OFFLINE_PASSPHRASE: Passphrase for the offline (root) key. Should be supplied only during root-key ceremonies, not in CI.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.NOTARY_AUTH_USER
observations: dct-env.NOTARY_AUTH: Optional basic-auth credentials for Notary server access (private notary instances).

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.gun-format
observations: dct-env.GUN (Globally Unique Name): Notary's term for a fully-qualified image repo. Format: `<registry-host>/<repo>` (no tag). Each GUN has its own trust-data tree.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.syscalls.errnoRet
observations: seccomp-profile-json.syscalls[].errnoRet: errno returned when action=SCMP_ACT_ERRNO. Default 1 (EPERM); commonly EACCES, ENOSYS for compat shimming.

name: docker.security.cfg.subuid-subgid-file.format
observations: subuid-subgid-file.username:start:count: `/etc/subuid` and `/etc/subgid` line format. e.g. `testuser:231072:65536` = uids 231072..296607 mapped into the user's namespace as 0..65535. Multi-range allowed (max 5 entries per kernel limit).

name: docker.security.cfg.subuid-subgid-file.minimum-65536
observations: subuid-subgid-file.minimum 65,536 ids: Per docs, you need ≥ 65,536 subordinate UIDs/GIDs for the user (one per possible container uid/gid).

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.PATH-injection
observations: rootless-env.PATH includes /usr/bin (rootless wrapper): Setuptool reminds: `export PATH=/usr/bin:$PATH` so the user's `docker` CLI picks up the right binary.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.seccomp-profile
observations: daemon.json-security.seccomp-profile: Default seccomp profile. `builtin` = moby's default.json (~44 syscalls blocked). Path = custom JSON. `unconfined` = no seccomp.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.oom-score-adjust
observations: daemon.json-security.oom-score-adjust: Daemon's OOM-killer preference. -500 keeps dockerd alive when host is memory-pressured.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.flags
observations: apparmor-profile-template.flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted): Profile flags. `attach_disconnected` = disconnected files mediated as parent; `mediate_deleted` = deleted files still mediated; `complain` = log without enforcing.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.file-rules
observations: apparmor-profile-template.<path> <permissions>,: Path-based access. Permissions: r=read, w=write, x=execute, l=link, k=lock, m=memory-map, ix=inherit-x, mr=mmap-read, k=lock, w=write. e.g. `/var/run/nginx.pid w,`. Globs `**`/`*`/`?`.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.tlscacert
observations: daemon-tls.--tlscacert: CA cert chain. With --tlsverify, only client certs signed by this CA are accepted.

name: docker.security.cfg.subuid-subgid-file.usermod-helper
observations: subuid-subgid-file.usermod --add-subuids/--add-subgids: Distro tool to manage subuid/subgid ranges. e.g. `usermod --add-subuids 100000-165535 alice`.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.syscalls.names
observations: seccomp-profile-json.syscalls[].names: Syscall name list (NOT numbers). e.g. `["open","openat","openat2"]`.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.signer-name
observations: dct-env.signer name (logical): Human-readable name for a delegation. Used in `docker trust key generate <name>` and `docker trust signer add <name> <gun>`. Surfaced in `docker trust inspect --pretty`.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.containerd-rootless-sock
observations: rootless-env.containerd rootless socket: Rootless containerd's grpc socket. Distinct from the system-wide /run/containerd/containerd.sock.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.systemctl-user-linger
observations: rootless-env.loginctl enable-linger <user>: Required for rootless dockerd to start at boot WITHOUT the user being logged in.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.insecure-registries
observations: daemon.json-security.insecure-registries: Registries dockerd will talk to over HTTP / with self-signed TLS. Adds attack surface — restrict to your private registry CIDRs.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.syscalls.excludes
observations: seccomp-profile-json.syscalls[].excludes: Skip this rule under these conditions. Inverse of includes.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_KILL
observations: seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_KILL: Kill the calling thread. Brutal but unambiguous.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST
observations: dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST: Set to `1` to enable DCT for `pull`, `push`, `build`, `create`, `run`. With it on, pulls reject unsigned tags; pushes auto-sign.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_MTU
observations: rootless-env.DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_MTU: MTU for rootless network. Lower for VPN-tunneled hosts.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.no-new-privileges
observations: daemon.json-security.no-new-privileges: Set the no_new_privs bit by default for new containers. Stops setuid binaries from gaining new caps.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.metrics-addr
observations: daemon.json-security.metrics-addr: Prometheus metrics endpoint. Bind to loopback (`127.0.0.1:9323`); exposing on `0.0.0.0` is an info-leak surface.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.dbus
observations: apparmor-profile-template.dbus: D-Bus messaging policy. Rare in container profiles.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.change_profile
observations: apparmor-profile-template.change_profile: Permission to switch to another profile mid-process. Highly restricted in container profiles.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.DOCKER_HOST-rootless
observations: rootless-env.DOCKER_HOST (rootless): Socket path of the rootless dockerd. The setuptool prints it in the install output.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_ERRNO
observations: seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_ERRNO: Return EPERM (or errnoRet) without invoking syscall. Default action of moby's default profile.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_TARGETS_PASSPHRASE
observations: dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_TARGETS_PASSPHRASE: Passphrase for the targets-of-targets key.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.default-ipc-mode
observations: daemon.json-security.default-ipc-mode: Default IPC namespace mode.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.rootless
observations: daemon.json-security.rootless: Mark the daemon as running in rootless mode. Set by `dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh`. Affects defaults: e.g. snapshotter falls back to fuse-overlayfs on older kernels.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.network-rules
observations: apparmor-profile-template.network <family> <type>,: Allow / deny network traffic by family + socket type. e.g. `network inet tcp,` or `deny network raw,`.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.tlscert
observations: daemon-tls.--tlscert: Daemon's server cert (or client's if on the CLI side).

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.capabilities
observations: apparmor-profile-template.capability <CAP>: Allow a capability. e.g. `capability chown,`. Default profile allows: chown, dac_override, fowner, fsetid, kill, setgid, setuid, setpcap, net_bind_service, net_raw, sys_chroot, mknod, audit_write, setfcap.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.tlsverify-flag
observations: daemon-tls.--tlsverify: Enable TLS + client cert verification (mTLS). dockerd refuses to start with TCP listener but no `--tlsverify`.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.client-DOCKER_CERT_PATH
observations: daemon-tls.DOCKER_CERT_PATH (client env): Dir containing ca.pem, cert.pem, key.pem on the client.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
observations: rootless-env.XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: Per-user runtime dir for sockets/pidfiles. Cleaned at logout — `loginctl enable-linger <user>` keeps it across logouts for persistent rootless services.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.hosts
observations: daemon.json-security.hosts: Daemon listen sockets. Re-keyed here to flag: TCP without TLS is rejected by the daemon; mTLS mandatory for any TCP exposure.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.defaultAction
observations: seccomp-profile-json.defaultAction: Action taken on syscalls not matched by syscalls[]. Values: SCMP_ACT_KILL, SCMP_ACT_KILL_PROCESS, SCMP_ACT_TRAP, SCMP_ACT_ERRNO[(errno)], SCMP_ACT_TRACE[(ret)], SCMP_ACT_ALLOW, SCMP_ACT_LOG, SCMP_ACT_NOTIFY. Docker default uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO (deny+EPERM).

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.architectures
observations: seccomp-profile-json.architectures: Architectures the filter applies to. e.g. `["SCMP_ARCH_X86_64","SCMP_ARCH_X86","SCMP_ARCH_X32"]` for amd64.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.profile-name
observations: apparmor-profile-template.profile <name>: Top-level profile declaration. Docker's default is `docker-default`. Custom: `profile docker-nginx flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) { ... }`.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.syscalls.action
observations: seccomp-profile-json.syscalls[].action: Override action for this syscall set. Most common in default profile: SCMP_ACT_ALLOW.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_LOG
observations: seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_LOG: Log the syscall + allow it. Monitor mode for testing new profiles before flipping to ERRNO/KILL.

name: docker.security.cfg.subuid-subgid-file.kernel-uid-map-limit
observations: subuid-subgid-file.5-entry kernel limit: `/proc/<pid>/uid_map` and gid_map accept at most 5 entries. Docker will use only the first 5 ranges if the file has more.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.group
observations: daemon.json-security.group: Unix group owning the docker.sock. Membership = root-equivalent (mount host fs in a container, escape). Treat as sudo membership.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.syscalls.comment
observations: seccomp-profile-json.syscalls[].comment: Free-text. Conventional in default profile to document WHY a syscall is blocked.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_ALLOW
observations: seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_ALLOW: Permit syscall. Used for the bulk of allowlist entries.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.tlskey
observations: daemon-tls.--tlskey: Private key matching tlscert.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_SERVER
observations: dct-env.DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_SERVER: Notary server URL. Override for self-hosted Notary.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon.json-security.experimental
observations: daemon.json-security.experimental: Re-keyed under daemon.json-security to flag the security implication: experimental features may have weaker security review. Engine catalogues the canonical key.

name: docker.security.cfg.seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_TRACE
observations: seccomp-profile-json.SCMP_ACT_TRACE: Notify a ptrace tracer; tracer can override return value (or kill). Used by sandboxes like nsjail / firejail.

name: docker.security.cfg.apparmor-profile-template.unix
observations: apparmor-profile-template.unix: AF_UNIX socket access policy.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.client-DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
observations: daemon-tls.DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY (client env): Any non-empty value enables mTLS on the client.

name: docker.security.cfg.daemon-tls.cn-cert-mapping
observations: daemon-tls.client cert CN: The CN/SAN of the client cert maps to a 'user' in some authorization plugins. Useful for per-user policy on the daemon API.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.DOCKER_TRUST_KEY_PASS
observations: dct-env.DOCKER_TRUST_KEY_PASS: Generic passphrase for any trust key being loaded via `docker trust key load`.

name: docker.security.cfg.dct-env.trust-store-dir
observations: dct-env.~/.docker/trust/: Local trust store: private keys under `private/<sha256>.key`, TUF metadata under `tuf/<server>/<repo>/`.

name: docker.security.cfg.subuid-subgid-file.dockremap-user
observations: subuid-subgid-file.dockremap (default): With `userns-remap: "default"`, dockerd creates the `dockremap` user + group and uses their subuid/subgid ranges.

name: docker.security.cfg.rootless-env.DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_NET
observations: rootless-env.DOCKERD_ROOTLESS_ROOTLESSKIT_NET: Rootless networking backend.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-mount-cache
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN --mount=type=cache,target=<path>[,id=<id>][,sharing=shared|private|locked][,from=<stage>][,uid=,gid=,mode=]: Persistent build cache mount. Common: `RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build go build`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ADD-checksum
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ADD --checksum=sha256:<hex>: Verify URL fetch checksum.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ENTRYPOINT-exec
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ENTRYPOINT ["executable", "arg"]: Exec-form. Preferred. The binary IS pid 1.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.MAINTAINER
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.MAINTAINER <email>: DEPRECATED. Use `LABEL org.opencontainers.image.authors=...` instead.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-parser-directive.check
observations: dockerfile-parser-directive.# check=skip=<rule>[;<rule>...] | error=true: Build-checks linter directive. e.g. `# check=skip=JSONArgsRecommended` to skip a check, `# check=error=true` to fail on warnings.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.binary
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].binary: Override runtime binary (e.g. `crun`).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.max-parallelism
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].max-parallelism: Max concurrent build steps.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.secret
observations: build-flag.--secret: Mount secret. Forms: id=<id>,src=<path> | id=<id>,env=<env-var>.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.bake-hcl-toml-json.target.args
observations: bake-hcl-toml-json.target.<name>.args: Build args for the target.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-exec
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN ["executable", "arg"]: Exec-form RUN. No shell wrapping; env vars NOT expanded.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ENTRYPOINT-shell
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ENTRYPOINT command: Shell-form. AVOID — pid 1 is /bin/sh, signals don't reach the binary.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY-link
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY --link: Copy in a separate layer that doesn't depend on prior layer's hash. Speeds up rebuilds when the layer above changes.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY-from-image
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY --from=<image>: Copy from an external image without a FROM stage. e.g. `COPY --from=alpine:3.20 /etc/ssl/certs /etc/ssl/certs`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY-chmod
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY --chmod=<mode>: Set permissions on the copied files (octal).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.trace
observations: buildkitd-toml.trace: Trace-level logging. Very verbose, perf hit.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.grpc.debugAddress
observations: buildkitd-toml.[grpc].debugAddress: pprof / debug HTTP server address.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.snapshotter
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].snapshotter: Snapshotter for OCI worker.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.rootless
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].rootless: Run worker in rootless mode.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.add-host
observations: build-flag.--add-host: /etc/hosts entries during build.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.force-compression
observations: cache-export-import-attr.force-compression: Force re-compression even if already in target format.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-mount-ssh
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN --mount=type=ssh[,id=<name>][,target=<path>][,uid=,gid=,mode=,required=true]: Forward host SSH agent socket. Pass key via CLI `--ssh default` or `--ssh id=<name>=<path>`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.LABEL
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.LABEL key=value [key=value...]: Image metadata. Standard keys: `org.opencontainers.image.{title,description,authors,vendor,licenses,source,documentation,version,revision,created}`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ONBUILD
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ONBUILD <instruction>: Trigger when a downstream image uses this image as base. Often surprising for downstream users — use sparingly.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.grpc.gid
observations: buildkitd-toml.[grpc].gid: GID owning the unix socket.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.grpc.tls.key
observations: buildkitd-toml.[grpc.tls].key: Server TLS key.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.history.maxEntries
observations: buildkitd-toml.[history].maxEntries: Max number of history entries kept.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.apparmor-profile
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].apparmor-profile: AppArmor profile for build containers (must already be loaded by the host).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.tag
observations: build-flag.-t, --tag: Tag for the built image. Repeatable.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.cpu-shares
observations: build-flag.--cpu-shares: CPU shares during build.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.bake-hcl-toml-json.target.context
observations: bake-hcl-toml-json.target.<name>.context: Per-target build context.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-network
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN --network=default|none|host: Network for this RUN. `none` blocks egress (security hardening); `host` requires `--allow=network.host` on the build.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY-from-stage
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY --from=<stage>: Copy from an earlier multi-stage stage by name (or index `--from=0`).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.grpc.tls.ca
observations: buildkitd-toml.[grpc.tls].ca: CA cert for client mTLS.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.push
observations: build-flag.--push: Shorthand for `--output type=registry`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.ssh
observations: build-flag.--ssh: SSH agent socket. `default` uses host SSH agent; `<id>=<path>` for a specific key file.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.allow
observations: build-flag.--allow: Grant build entitlements: `network.host`, `security.insecure`, `device`. Daemon must list these in `insecure-entitlements`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.bake-hcl-toml-json.target.dockerfile
observations: bake-hcl-toml-json.target.<name>.dockerfile: Dockerfile path.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.CMD-shell
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.CMD command arg: Shell-form CMD. Wrapped in /bin/sh -c.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-parser-directive.experimental-1-labs
observations: dockerfile-parser-directive.# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1-labs: Opt into experimental Dockerfile syntax (new instructions, mount types). Lands in mainline `:1` once stable.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.insecure-entitlements
observations: buildkitd-toml.insecure-entitlements: Entitlements buildkitd will grant when requested. Allowed values: network.host, security.insecure, device.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.load
observations: build-flag.--load: Shorthand for `--output type=docker`. Single-platform only.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-here-doc
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN <<EOF ... EOF: Multi-line script as a heredoc. Cleaner than `&&`-chained one-liners. Variants `<<-EOF` (strip leading tabs), `<<"EOF"` (no var interpolation).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ADD-url
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ADD <URL> <dest>: Fetch URL during build. Use `--checksum=sha256:<hex>` for integrity.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ENV
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ENV KEY=VALUE [KEY=VALUE...]: Set environment variables for subsequent instructions AND for the running container.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.EXPOSE
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.EXPOSE <port>[/<proto>]: Declare ports. Pure metadata. Default proto tcp. -P consumes EXPOSE'd ports.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.VOLUME
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.VOLUME ["<path>"]: Declare a path as anonymous-volume mount point. Forms: JSON array (exec form) or whitespace-separated.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.log.format
observations: buildkitd-toml.[log].format: Log output format.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.history.maxAge
observations: buildkitd-toml.[history].maxAge: Max age of build-history entries.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.gc
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].gc: Enable garbage collection.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.shm-size
observations: build-flag.--shm-size: /dev/shm size during build.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.FROM
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.FROM <image>[:<tag>|@<digest>] [AS <stage>]: Set base image for the next stage. `FROM scratch` for empty rootfs. Pin to digest for reproducibility.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-mount-secret
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN --mount=type=secret,id=<name>[,target=<path>][,uid=,gid=,mode=,required=true]: Mount a CLI-supplied secret. Default target `/run/secrets/<id>`. Secret content NEVER in layers.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-security
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN --security=insecure|sandbox: `insecure` runs RUN with full host privileges (needs `--allow=security.insecure`). For when you really need to mknod, mount, etc. during build.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.HEALTHCHECK-NONE
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.HEALTHCHECK NONE: Clear any inherited HEALTHCHECK from base image.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-parser-directive.syntax
observations: dockerfile-parser-directive.# syntax=<frontend-image>: Pin frontend image. Forms: `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1`, `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.6`, `# syntax=docker/dockerfile@sha256:...`, `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1-labs` (experimental). Must be at top of file.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.provenanceEnvDir
observations: buildkitd-toml.provenanceEnvDir: Dir of extra config files added to provenance (SLSA invocation environment).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.platforms
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].platforms: Declared platforms (auto-detected if unset).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.frontend-gateway-v0
observations: buildkitd-toml.[frontend."gateway.v0"].enabled: Enable gateway frontend (lets users specify custom frontend images via `# syntax=`).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.metadata-file
observations: build-flag.--metadata-file: Write build metadata JSON.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.builder
observations: build-flag.--builder: Override default buildx builder.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.progress
observations: build-flag.--progress: Progress format. plain for CI logs.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.dest
observations: cache-export-import-attr.dest: Cache-export destination dir (local/oci types).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-containerd.runtime
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.containerd.runtime]: Containerd runtime config used by the worker.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.memory
observations: build-flag.--memory, -m: Memory limit during build.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.image-manifest
observations: cache-export-import-attr.image-manifest: Use OCI image manifest format (vs OCI image index) — required by some registries.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY [--from=<stage|image>] [--chown=<u:g>] [--chmod=<mode>] [--link] <src>... <dest>: Copy files. `--link` makes a layer-decoupled copy (faster rebuilds when prior layers change).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ADD-keep-git-dir
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ADD --keep-git-dir=true <git-url> <dest>: Preserve .git dir when source is a git URL.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY-parents
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY --parents <src>... <dest>: Preserve the parent directory structure when copying multiple sources. e.g. `COPY --parents foo/file1.txt bar/file2.txt /dest/` keeps the foo/ and bar/ subdirs.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-parser-directive.position
observations: dockerfile-parser-directive.directives must be at top: Parser directives end as soon as the parser hits a non-directive line (instruction, blank line, or non-directive comment). Order: syntax, escape, check (any order at top).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.dns.options
observations: buildkitd-toml.[dns].options: resolv.conf options.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-containerd.address
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.containerd].address: containerd socket when using containerd worker.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.registry-insecure
observations: buildkitd-toml.[registry."<host>"].insecure: HTTPS with self-signed cert.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.system.platformsCacheMaxAge
observations: buildkitd-toml.[system].platformsCacheMaxAge: How often buildkit re-scans for emulated platforms.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.network
observations: build-flag.--network: Network for RUN. `host` requires `--allow=network.host`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.label
observations: build-flag.--label: Image labels.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.cpu-period
observations: build-flag.--cpu-period: CFS period during build.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.s3-bucket
observations: cache-export-import-attr.bucket (s3): S3 bucket name.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ARG
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ARG NAME[=default]: Build-time variable. Visible after declaration. Pass via CLI `--build-arg NAME=val`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ARG-auto-platform
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.BUILDPLATFORM, TARGETPLATFORM, TARGETOS, TARGETARCH, TARGETVARIANT (auto-injected): Auto-set ARGs in multi-platform builds. `BUILDPLATFORM` = where the build runs; `TARGETPLATFORM` = what we build for. Use to fetch arch-specific binaries.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.USER
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.USER <uid|name>[:<gid|group>]: Set user for subsequent RUN/CMD/ENTRYPOINT. Hardening: drop to non-root.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-parser-directive.first-non-directive-ends
observations: dockerfile-parser-directive.non-directive line ends parser: After the first non-directive line, all subsequent `# ...=...` lines are normal comments. Common foot-gun.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.cdi.disabled
observations: buildkitd-toml.[cdi].disabled: Disable CDI (Container Device Interface) support.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.frontend-dockerfile-v0
observations: buildkitd-toml.[frontend."dockerfile.v0"].enabled: Enable Dockerfile frontend.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.oci-mediatypes
observations: cache-export-import-attr.oci-mediatypes: Use OCI media types (vs Docker v2-2).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.s3-region
observations: cache-export-import-attr.region (s3): S3 region.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.s3-prefix
observations: cache-export-import-attr.prefix (s3): Key prefix within bucket.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-shell
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN <command>: Shell-form RUN. Wrapped in /bin/sh -c (or what SHELL was set to).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-mount-bind
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN --mount=type=bind,source=<path>,target=<path>[,from=<stage>][,rw]: Bind-mount context or another stage into RUN. Read-only by default.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.CMD-exec
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.CMD ["executable", "arg"]: Exec-form CMD. Default. Preferred for production — signals propagate.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.CMD-default-args
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.CMD ["arg1", "arg2"]: Default arguments to ENTRYPOINT (when ENTRYPOINT is set in exec form).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.STOPSIGNAL
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.STOPSIGNAL <signal>: Default kill signal. e.g. nginx uses SIGQUIT for graceful drain.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.root
observations: buildkitd-toml.root: Persistent state root.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.dns.searchDomains
observations: buildkitd-toml.[dns].searchDomains: DNS search domains.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.registry-ca
observations: buildkitd-toml.[registry."<host>"].ca: CA cert files trusted for this registry.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.no-cache
observations: build-flag.--no-cache: Disable cache for all stages.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.cache-to
observations: build-flag.--cache-to: Export cache.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.output
observations: build-flag.-o, --output: Output dest. type=image (default), type=local,dest=<dir>, type=tar,dest=- , type=registry, type=docker, type=oci.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN-mount-tmpfs
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.RUN --mount=type=tmpfs,target=<path>[,size=<bytes>]: In-memory tmpfs for the duration of one RUN.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-parser-directive.escape
observations: dockerfile-parser-directive.# escape=<char>: Line-continuation char. Set to backtick on Windows where backslash is path separator: `# escape=` ` `` ``.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.debug
observations: buildkitd-toml.debug: Enable debug-level logging.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.reservedSpace
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].reservedSpace: Min disk space guaranteed retained — never reclaimed.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.minFreeSpace
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].minFreeSpace: Target free space the GC tries to leave.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.cniPoolSize
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].cniPoolSize: Reusable CNI netns pool size — amortizes ns alloc/release.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.file
observations: build-flag.-f, --file: Dockerfile path.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.build-arg
observations: build-flag.--build-arg: Set ARG. Without `=VAL`, inherits from caller's env.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.target
observations: build-flag.--target: Build a specific multi-stage target.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.sbom
observations: build-flag.--sbom: Shorthand for --attest type=sbom,...

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.memory-swap
observations: build-flag.--memory-swap: Memory + swap during build.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.ref
observations: cache-export-import-attr.ref: Registry-cache image ref. e.g. `myreg/myapp:cache`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.bake-hcl-toml-json.target.platforms
observations: bake-hcl-toml-json.target.<name>.platforms: Target platforms.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY-here-doc
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.COPY <<EOF /path: Heredoc COPY — write inline content into a file in the image without a separate context file.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ADD-tar
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ADD <local.tar.gz> <dest>: Auto-extract local tarball (.tar, .tar.gz, .tar.bz2, .tar.xz) — surprising behavior; usually prefer COPY.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ARG-global
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.ARG NAME (before first FROM): Global ARG — available to FROM instructions for image tag interpolation. e.g. `ARG IMAGE_TAG=latest` then `FROM nginx:$IMAGE_TAG`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.WORKDIR
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.WORKDIR <path>: Set cwd. Auto-creates if missing.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-parser-directive.no-interpolation
observations: dockerfile-parser-directive.no var interpolation in directives: `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:$VERSION` does NOT expand $VERSION. Pin literally.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.grpc.address
observations: buildkitd-toml.[grpc].address: gRPC listen addresses. Forms: unix://, tcp://, npipe:// (Windows). Repeatable.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.otel.socketPath
observations: buildkitd-toml.[otel].socketPath: OTEL collector trace socket path.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-containerd.namespace
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.containerd].namespace: containerd namespace.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.registry-http
observations: buildkitd-toml.[registry."<host>"].http: Use plain HTTP. Mutually exclusive with `insecure`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.registry-keypair
observations: buildkitd-toml.[[registry."<host>".keypair]]: Client TLS keypair for this registry.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.cache-from
observations: build-flag.--cache-from: Import cache. See cache-export-import-attr scope.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.type
observations: cache-export-import-attr.type: Cache backend type.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.src
observations: cache-export-import-attr.src: Cache-import source dir (local types).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.compression-level
observations: cache-export-import-attr.compression-level: Compression level (driver-specific range).

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.bake-hcl-toml-json.variable.default
observations: bake-hcl-toml-json.variable.<name>.default: Bake variable default. Override via env or `--set`.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.dockerfile-instruction-keyword.HEALTHCHECK-CMD
observations: dockerfile-instruction-keyword.HEALTHCHECK [OPTIONS] CMD <command>: In-image health probe. Options: --interval, --timeout, --retries, --start-period, --start-interval.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.dns.nameservers
observations: buildkitd-toml.[dns].nameservers: DNS servers for build steps.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.grpc.uid
observations: buildkitd-toml.[grpc].uid: UID owning the unix socket.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.grpc.tls.cert
observations: buildkitd-toml.[grpc.tls].cert: Server TLS cert.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.cdi.specDirs
observations: buildkitd-toml.[cdi].specDirs: Dirs to scan for CDI spec files.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.maxUsedSpace
observations: buildkitd-toml.[worker.oci].maxUsedSpace: Max disk space allowed — usage above is reclaimed by GC.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.buildkitd-toml.worker-oci.gcpolicy
observations: buildkitd-toml.[[worker.oci.gcpolicy]]: Per-policy GC. Filters: type==source.local, type==exec.cachemount, type==source.git.checkout, etc. `all=true` matches everything.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.platform
observations: build-flag.--platform: Target platform(s). Multi-platform requires a non-`docker` driver and an `--output` type that supports manifest lists.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.no-cache-filter
observations: build-flag.--no-cache-filter: Disable cache for specific stages only. Repeatable.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.pull
observations: build-flag.--pull: Always pull base images.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.attest
observations: build-flag.--attest: Attach attestations. e.g. type=provenance,mode=max | type=sbom.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.build-flag.provenance
observations: build-flag.--provenance: Shorthand for --attest type=provenance,...

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.mode
observations: cache-export-import-attr.mode: `min` saves only final image layers; `max` saves all intermediate. `max` is much faster on cache hits but ~3-5x larger.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.gha-name
observations: cache-export-import-attr.name (gha): Name for the gha cache entry.

name: docker.build-buildkit.cfg.cache-export-import-attr.compression
