name: k8s.runtime.cfg.containerd.registry-config-path
observations: containerd-config.registry.config_path: Per-registry mirrors + auth + TLS config dir.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.runtimeclass.overhead
observations: runtimeclass-spec.overhead: podFixed resource use of the runtime itself.

observations: cri-version.v1: Stable CRI version. Use this with modern kubelet.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.cri.cri-version-alpha

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.kubelet-cgroup.kubepods-slice
observations: cgroup-path./sys/fs/cgroup/kubepods.slice: Top of kubelet's cgroup tree (systemd driver).

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.kubelet-cgroup.qos-besteffort
observations: cgroup-path./kubepods.slice/kubepods-besteffort.slice: BestEffort QoS pods.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.kubelet-cgroup.qos-burstable
observations: cgroup-path./kubepods.slice/kubepods-burstable.slice: Burstable pods.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.kubelet-cgroup.guaranteed
observations: cgroup-path./kubepods.slice: Guaranteed pods (top-level slice itself).

observations: kubelet-port.10250: HTTPS API. exec/logs/portforward/stats. Authn+authz required.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.kubelet-port.10248
observations: kubelet-port.10248: Healthz (localhost only).

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.kubelet-port.10255
observations: kubelet-port.10255: Read-only HTTP (insecure, default disabled).

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.kube-proxy-port.10256

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.kube-proxy-port.10249
observations: kube-proxy-port.10249: kube-proxy /metrics + /healthz alt port.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.image.pause-version
observations: image-name.registry.k8s.io/pause:3.x: Pause container image. Update during k8s minor bumps.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.deviceplugin.dir
observations: device-plugin-path./var/lib/kubelet/device-plugins: Device plugins register sockets here.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.csi.dir
observations: csi-plugin-path./var/lib/kubelet/plugins: CSI driver sockets.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.cni.config-dir
observations: cni-config-path./etc/cni/net.d: .conflist files for active CNI plugins.

name: k8s.runtime.cfg.cni.bin-dir
observations: cni-config-path./opt/cni/bin: CNI plugin binaries.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint.runs-on
observations: blueprint.runs-on: Top-level blueprint field selecting target platform. String or list. Allowed values: `default` (alias for linux), `linux`, `windows`. List form (`[default, windows]`) runs identical commands on each platform, producing one snapshot per platform. For platform-specific commands use multi-block YAML.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint.initialize
observations: blueprint.initialize: Top-level blueprint section. Holds steps that run ONCE during builds; results persist in the snapshot. Use for language runtimes, system packages, global CLI tools.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint.maintenance
observations: blueprint.maintenance: Top-level blueprint section. Runs during builds AND surfaced (not auto-executed) to the agent at session start. Should be fast and incremental; use `npm install`, not `npm ci`.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint.knowledge
observations: blueprint.knowledge: Top-level blueprint section. Reference info loaded into Devin's context at session start (NOT executed). Lightweight, focused on executable command refs (lint/test/build).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint-step.name
observations: blueprint-step.name: Human-readable label for a blueprint step. Surfaced in build logs.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint-step.run
observations: blueprint-step.run: Shell-script body for a blueprint step. Must be non-interactive — interactive commands hang and time out. Subject to a 1-hour per-step timeout.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint-step.uses
observations: blueprint-step.uses: GitHub Action reference, e.g., `github.com/actions/setup-node@v4`. Devin downloads and runs the action during build, the same way GitHub CI runners execute action steps. Supported for setup-python, setup-node, setup-go, etc.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint-step.with
observations: blueprint-step.with: Inputs passed to a referenced GitHub Action. E.g., `with: { node-version: '20' }` for `actions/setup-node@v4`.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint-knowledge-entry.name
observations: blueprint-knowledge-entry.name: Identifier for a knowledge entry — e.g., `lint`, `test`, `build`. Used by Devin to look up the canonical command for a category.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint-knowledge-entry.contents
observations: blueprint-knowledge-entry.contents: Body of a knowledge entry — typically a single executable command (e.g., `npm run lint`). NOT executed by the runtime; loaded into Devin's context as reference info.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.blueprint.multi-document-separator
observations: blueprint.---: Multi-document YAML separator. Lets a single blueprint editor file contain multiple blocks — used for multi-platform blueprints (one block per `runs-on`) and for organizing complex blueprints into logical sections.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.secret.reference-syntax
observations: secrets.$VARIABLE_NAME: Reference syntax for secrets stored in Devin's Secrets dashboard. Available in blueprint shell commands and live session shells. Place credential-writing steps in `maintenance` (not `initialize`) so credentials are refreshed on each periodic build.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.timing.build-step-timeout
observations: build-timing.step-timeout: Per-step timeout during a build. Steps exceeding this are killed and the build fails. Common cause of hits: compiling large native dependencies from source — use pre-built binaries instead. Also triggered by commands waiting for interactive input.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.timing.setup-command-timeout
observations: build-timing.setup-command-timeout: Timeout for a single command during the classic-config repo-setup wizard. Cognition explicitly recommends against giving Devin commands that take longer than 5 minutes — performance degrades significantly.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.timing.periodic-refresh-cadence
observations: build-timing.periodic-refresh-cadence: Approximate cadence at which builds run automatically to refresh dependencies. Skipped while a snapshot is pinned.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.timing.pin-age-limit
observations: build-timing.pin-age-limit: Maximum age of a build that's still pinnable. Builds older than 7 days cannot be pinned. Status must also be Success or Partial.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.timing.typical-build-duration
observations: build-timing.typical-build-duration: Typical end-to-end build time for an org's blueprint(s). Used for capacity planning when waiting on a fresh snapshot.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.runtime.home-dir-linux
observations: filesystem.home-dir.linux: Default home directory for the DevBox user on Linux. Used in path-based blueprint commands that need an absolute reference.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.runtime.home-dir-windows
observations: filesystem.home-dir.windows: Default home directory on Windows DevBox (Git-Bash-style path).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.runtime.repos-dir
observations: filesystem.repos-dir: Per-repo working-tree path. On Linux: /home/ubuntu/repos/<repo-name>. On Windows: /c/Users/Administrator/repos/<repo-name>. Each configured repo lives in its own subdirectory.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.runtime.file-attachments-dir
observations: filesystem.file-attachments-dir: Directory where uploaded files are written. Linux: /home/ubuntu/.files/. Windows: /c/Users/Administrator/.files/. Files dragged-and-dropped into the embedded VS Code instance land here.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.runtime.cdp-endpoint
observations: browser.cdp-endpoint: Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint exposed by DevBox's Chrome browser. Playwright connects here for browser-based authentication automation and systematic data entry.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.bashrc.path
observations: shell.~/.bashrc: User shell init file inside DevBox. Direnv hook is pre-configured. Common edits: PATH manipulation, per-repo `nvm use` cd-hooks. Edit via `devin ~/.bashrc`.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.direnv.envrc-filename
observations: direnv..envrc: Per-repo environment-variable file consumed by direnv. Created at the repo root; loaded after running `direnv allow` once.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.vpn.openvpn-config-path
observations: vpn.openvpn.config-path: Location to which the user uploads `config.ovpn`. Drag-and-drop into the VS Code instance; choose any path in DevBox (typically /etc/openvpn/ or ~/).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.vpn.systemd-service-unit
observations: vpn.systemd.openvpn.service: Path to the systemd unit file that auto-starts OpenVPN at session boot. Created by the user during VPN setup; references the config.ovpn from the previous step.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.network.outbound-ip.1
observations: outbound-ip-allowlist.outbound-ip-1: Devin egress IP — must be allowlisted on customer firewalls / SCM allowlists / internal services. Documented in Admin > Common Issues > IP Whitelisting.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.network.outbound-ip.2
observations: outbound-ip-allowlist.outbound-ip-2: Devin egress IP (allowlist target).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.network.outbound-ip.3
observations: outbound-ip-allowlist.outbound-ip-3: Devin egress IP (allowlist target).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.network.outbound-ip.4
observations: outbound-ip-allowlist.outbound-ip-4: Devin egress IP (allowlist target).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.network.outbound-ip.5
observations: outbound-ip-allowlist.outbound-ip-5: Devin egress IP (allowlist target).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.network.outbound-ip.6
observations: outbound-ip-allowlist.outbound-ip-6: Devin egress IP (allowlist target).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.network.outbound-ip.7
observations: outbound-ip-allowlist.outbound-ip-7: Devin egress IP (allowlist target).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.repo-state.configured
observations: repo-state.Configured: Repo state: has a blueprint with initialize/maintenance/knowledge — fully set up in the snapshot.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.repo-state.included
observations: repo-state.Included: Repo state: cloned into the snapshot but no custom blueprint. Devin can read the code but has no setup commands for it.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.repo-state.available
observations: repo-state.Available: Repo state: connected to the org but not added to the environment. Not cloned. Visible in repo selector but not yet usable.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.build-status.success
observations: build-status.Success: Build status: all steps completed; snapshot is ready to use.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.build-status.partial
observations: build-status.Partial: Build status: some repo-level steps failed; snapshot is usable. Repos that succeeded work normally; repos that failed need their blueprints fixed.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.build-status.failed
observations: build-status.Failed: Build status: critical failure (org or enterprise tier setup failed). Snapshot is NOT usable.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.build-status.cancelled
observations: build-status.Cancelled: Build status: superseded by a newer build or manually cancelled.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.billing.session-acu-soft-cap
observations: billing.session-acu-soft-cap: Cognition's recommended per-session ACU ceiling. Beyond ~10 ACU per session, agent performance noticeably degrades. Soft cap (the product nudges, doesn't enforce).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.billing.usage-budget-bill-trigger
observations: billing.usage-budget-bill-trigger: Threshold above which usage-based billing triggers an immediate bill (rather than waiting for end-of-cycle). Whichever comes first: hitting $2,000 in additional usage OR end of billing cycle.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.workspace.large-performant-toggle-path
observations: ui-path.large-performant-toggle: UI location of the Large Performant (Beta) VM-tier toggle. Default for new teams; existing teams must opt in (requires resetting machine setup; experimental auto-migration via support@cognition.ai).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.windows.shell
observations: windows-runtime.default-shell: Default shell on Windows DevBox. Same bash semantics as Linux DevBox — most blueprint commands work cross-platform without modification.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.windows.path-format
observations: windows-runtime.path-format: Git Bash path style on Windows DevBox (e.g., /c/Users/Administrator instead of C:\Users\Administrator). Required when Windows-specific paths appear in blueprint commands.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.windows.package-managers
observations: windows-runtime.package-managers: Available package managers on Windows DevBox: Chocolatey (choco), winget, or direct download scripts. apt-get is NOT available.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.linux.package-manager
observations: linux-runtime.package-manager: Default package manager on Linux DevBox.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.agents-md.section.setup-commands
observations: agents-md.Setup Commands: AGENTS.md section listing setup commands the agent should run. Devin reads this before starting work. Example entries: 'Install dependencies: npm install', 'Start development server: npm run dev', 'Run tests: npm test', 'Build for production: npm run build'.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.agents-md.section.code-style
observations: agents-md.Code Style: AGENTS.md section listing code-style requirements (e.g., 'Use TypeScript strict mode', 'Prefer functional components in React', 'Use ESLint and Prettier configurations').

name: devin.devbox.cfg.agents-md.section.testing-guidelines
observations: agents-md.Testing Guidelines: AGENTS.md section listing testing requirements (frameworks, coverage targets, when to run).

name: devin.devbox.cfg.agents-md.section.project-structure
observations: agents-md.Project Structure: AGENTS.md section enumerating top-level directories (e.g., '/src - Main application code', '/tests - Test files', '/docs - Documentation', '/public - Static assets').

name: devin.devbox.cfg.agents-md.section.development-workflow
observations: agents-md.Development Workflow: AGENTS.md section describing branching/PR/commit conventions.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.security.encryption-in-transit
observations: security.encryption-in-transit: All data transmission encrypted in transit. Production systems also routinely monitored via logging, error handling, live-metrics dashboards.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.security.encryption-at-rest
observations: security.encryption-at-rest: Data encrypted at rest in Cognition's AWS production environment.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.security.data-controls.training-opt-in
observations: data-controls.training-opt-in: Whether the customer's data may be used for Cognition model training. Default false (opt-out by default). Toggle on the Data Controls settings page. Enterprise customers' data is NEVER used for training regardless of toggle.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.security.mfa-required
observations: security.mfa-required: All Cognition employees and contractors required to use multi-factor authentication on all main work applications.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.security.cloud-region
observations: security.cloud-region: Cognition's production cloud environment is hosted in AWS.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.security.vulnerability-disclosure-email
observations: security.vulnerability-disclosure-email: Address for security vulnerability reports. Documented in Admin > Security.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.security.support-email
observations: support.support-email: Customer-support contact address. Used for VM-tier auto-migration requests, integration issues, and other operational asks.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.status-page.component.web-client
observations: status-component.Web Client: Status-page component representing the Devin web app. Reported uptime ~99.92% over 90 days at fetch time.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.status-page.component.agent
observations: status-component.Agent: Status-page component representing Devin's agent runtime. Reported uptime ~99.83% at fetch time.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.status-page.component.integrations
observations: status-component.Integrations: Status-page component representing third-party integrations. Reported uptime ~100% at fetch time.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.status-page.component.enterprise
observations: status-component.Enterprise: Status-page component representing the Enterprise plane. Reported uptime ~99.9% at fetch time.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.status-page.component.web-client-enterprise
observations: status-component.Web Client (Enterprise): Status-page component for the enterprise web app surface. Reported uptime ~99.92% at fetch time.

name: devin.devbox.cfg.status-page.component.agent-enterprise
observations: status-component.Agent (Enterprise): Status-page component for the enterprise agent runtime. Reported uptime ~99.88% at fetch time.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.dependabot-alerts
observations: github-app-permission.dependabot_alerts: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to resolve dependabot alerts (i.e., bumping dependency versions).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.actions
observations: github-app-permission.actions: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to view configured Actions to understand if its changes pass CI.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.deployments
observations: github-app-permission.deployments: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to view which versions of a repository were deployed.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.metadata
observations: github-app-permission.metadata: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to view crucial repository metadata such as ownership.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.packages
observations: github-app-permission.packages: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to view which versions of a repo were shipped as a package.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.pages
observations: github-app-permission.pages: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to consult GitHub Pages associated with a repo (e.g., to view documentation).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.security-advisories
observations: github-app-permission.repository_security_advisories: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to view security advisories to help fix security issues.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.members
observations: github-app-permission.members: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to view members of an organization.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.read.webhooks
observations: github-app-permission.webhooks: GitHub App permission. Read access. Allows Devin to view configured hooks (e.g., linting, type-checking).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.write.checks
observations: github-app-permission.checks: GitHub App permission. Read+write. Allows Devin to view and report check results — communicate CI pass/fail.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.write.commit-statuses
observations: github-app-permission.commit_statuses: GitHub App permission. Read+write. Allows Devin to view and set commit statuses indicating CI pass/fail.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.write.contents
observations: github-app-permission.contents: GitHub App permission. Read+write. Allows Devin to contribute to the codebase.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.write.discussions
observations: github-app-permission.discussions: GitHub App permission. Read+write. Allows Devin to contribute to GitHub Discussions.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.write.issues
observations: github-app-permission.issues: GitHub App permission. Read+write. Allows Devin to open new issues.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.write.pull-requests
observations: github-app-permission.pull_requests: GitHub App permission. Read+write. Allows Devin to create new PRs.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.write.projects
observations: github-app-permission.projects: GitHub App permission. Read+write. Allows Devin to view and manage projects associated with a repo (task retrieval).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.github-perm.write.workflows
observations: github-app-permission.workflows: GitHub App permission. Read+write. Allows Devin to set up new workflows (CI/CD configuration).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.pr-template.search.devin-uppercase-1
observations: pr-template-search.PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/devin_pr_template.md: First search path for Devin-specific PR template. Both uppercase and lowercase variants are supported.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.pr-template.search.devin-docs
observations: pr-template-search.docs/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/devin_pr_template.md: Second search path for Devin-specific PR template (under docs/).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.pr-template.search.devin-github
observations: pr-template-search..github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/devin_pr_template.md: Third search path for Devin-specific PR template (under .github/).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.pr-template.search.standard-root
observations: pr-template-search.pull_request_template.md: Fourth search path — standard GitHub PR template at repo root. Both uppercase and lowercase variants supported.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.pr-template.search.standard-docs
observations: pr-template-search.docs/pull_request_template.md: Fifth search path — standard PR template under docs/.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.pr-template.search.standard-github
observations: pr-template-search..github/pull_request_template.md: Sixth search path — standard PR template under .github/.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.pr-template.fallback-default
observations: pr-template.fallback-default-template: If none of the search paths match, Devin falls back to a built-in default template with sections: Summary, Review & Testing Checklist, (Optional) Mermaid diagram, Notes.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.gpg-signing.git-user-name
observations: gpg-signing.GIT_USER_NAME: Devin secret holding the git user.name to set on signed commits. Must match the GPG key UID's name.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.gpg-signing.git-user-email
observations: gpg-signing.GIT_USER_EMAIL: Devin secret holding the git user.email. Must match the GPG key UID's email AND the GitHub account where the public key is uploaded — GitHub verifies signatures against the commit author identity.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.gpg-signing.private-key-base64
observations: gpg-signing.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64: Base64-encoded GPG private key, stored as a Devin secret. Imported at session start by the org-wide blueprint to enable commit signing.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.slack-perm.chat-write
observations: slack-permission.chat:write, chat:write.customize: Slack OAuth scopes. Send messages as @Devin or with a customized username/avatar. Required for Devin to respond to user requests.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.slack-perm.commands
observations: slack-permission.commands: Slack OAuth scope. Add shortcuts and slash commands.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.slack-perm.files
observations: slack-permission.files:read, files:write, remote_files:read, remote_files:write: Slack OAuth scopes. Upload, edit, delete files (including remote files). Required for sending/receiving attachments.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.slack-perm.history
observations: slack-permission.channels:history, groups:history, im:history: Slack OAuth scopes. View messages and content in channels/groups/DMs Devin is in. Required to retrieve thread context when launched mid-thread.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.slack-perm.im
observations: slack-permission.im:read, im:write: Slack OAuth scopes. Start DMs with people; view basic info about DMs Devin is in. Required for the per-run notification feature.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.slack-perm.reactions
observations: slack-permission.reactions:write: Slack OAuth scope. Add/edit emoji reactions. Used to mark runs as completed or failed.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.slack-perm.users
observations: slack-permission.users:read, users:read.email, users.profile:read: Slack OAuth scopes. View workspace users + emails + profiles. Required to match Slack users with Devin users by email.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-graph.organization-read-all
observations: teams-graph-permission.Organization.Read.All: Microsoft Graph Application permission (tenant-wide). Read basic org profile. Used to validate the tenant where the app is being installed.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-graph.user-readbasic-all
observations: teams-graph-permission.User.ReadBasic.All: Microsoft Graph Application permission. Read basic user profiles. Used to map member identities and resolve mentions in linked Teams.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-graph.appcatalog-read-all
observations: teams-graph-permission.AppCatalog.Read.All: Microsoft Graph Application permission. Read the Teams app catalog. Used to locate Devin's app and fetch teamsAppId for installation.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-graph.app-install-rwc
observations: teams-graph-permission.TeamsAppInstallation.ReadWriteAndConsentSelfForTeam.All: Microsoft Graph Application permission. Install/uninstall Devin's own app and grant app RSC. Used to install/remove the bot in a selected Team from the Devin dashboard.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-rsc.channel-message-read
observations: teams-rsc-permission.ChannelMessage.Read.Group: Teams RSC. Per Team/Channel. Read channel messages where the app is installed. Used to process channel conversations (summaries, triggers, syncing).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-rsc.channel-message-send
observations: teams-rsc-permission.ChannelMessage.Send.Group: Teams RSC. Send messages in channels (new posts and threaded replies) where the app is installed.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-rsc.member-read
observations: teams-rsc-permission.Member.Read.Group: Teams RSC. Read team membership. Used for identity mapping, permission checks, mention routing.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-rsc.team-settings-read
observations: teams-rsc-permission.TeamSettings.Read.Group: Teams RSC. Read Team settings. Used to respect Team-level policies and tailor behavior.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-rsc.chat-member-read
observations: teams-rsc-permission.ChatMember.Read.Chat: Teams RSC. Read chat participants. Used for response addressing and audit trails.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-rsc.chat-message-read
observations: teams-rsc-permission.ChatMessage.Read.Chat: Teams RSC. Read messages in chats where the bot participates. Used to process prompts, context, follow-ups.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-rsc.chat-message-send
observations: teams-rsc-permission.ChatMessage.Send.Chat: Teams RSC. Send messages in 1:1 and group chats (DMs) where the bot participates. NOT for channels.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.teams-rsc.chat-settings-read
observations: teams-rsc-permission.ChatSettings.Read.Chat: Teams RSC. Read chat settings (e.g., moderation). Used to align behavior with chat policies (rate limits, who can post, etc.).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira-oauth.scope.read-me
observations: jira-oauth-scope.read:me: Jira OAuth 2.0 Classic scope. Read the authenticated user's profile.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira-oauth.scope.read-jira-user
observations: jira-oauth-scope.read:jira-user: Jira OAuth 2.0 Classic scope. Read Jira users.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira-oauth.scope.read-jira-work
observations: jira-oauth-scope.read:jira-work: Jira OAuth 2.0 Classic scope. Read Jira work items (issues, projects).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira-oauth.scope.write-jira-work
observations: jira-oauth-scope.write:jira-work: Jira OAuth 2.0 Classic scope. Write Jira work items — create/update issues/comments under the service-account identity.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.automation-trigger.semantics
observations: automation-trigger.edge-detection: Automation triggers (Jira and Linear) use edge detection. They fire on transition INTO a matching state, not for tickets already matching when the trigger is configured.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira-trigger.projects
observations: jira-automation-trigger.projects: Jira automation-trigger filter. Only fire for tickets in specified Jira projects.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira-trigger.labels
observations: jira-automation-trigger.labels: Jira automation-trigger filter. Only fire when a ticket has these labels.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira-trigger.statuses
observations: jira-automation-trigger.statuses: Jira automation-trigger filter. Only fire when a ticket reaches one of these statuses (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress').

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira-trigger.playbook
observations: jira-automation-trigger.playbook: Jira automation-trigger optional override. Specifies which playbook to use for the auto-triggered session.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.linear-trigger.teams
observations: linear-automation-trigger.teams: Linear automation-trigger filter. Only fire for tickets in these Linear teams.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.linear-trigger.labels
observations: linear-automation-trigger.labels: Linear automation-trigger filter. Only fire when a ticket has these labels.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.linear-trigger.statuses
observations: linear-automation-trigger.statuses: Linear automation-trigger filter. Only fire when a ticket reaches one of these statuses (e.g., 'Todo', 'In Progress').

name: devin.integrations.cfg.linear-trigger.playbook
observations: linear-automation-trigger.playbook: Linear automation-trigger optional override. Specifies which playbook to use for the auto-triggered session.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.linear.default-playbook
observations: linear.default-playbook: Default playbook used when a Linear ticket is assigned to Devin without a specific playbook label. Set to `!plan` for new connections.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira.session-mode
observations: jira.session-mode: Jira session-mode toggle. Values: `direct` (Devin creates a full session, posts updates back) or `scoping` (Devin only analyzes and posts a scoping comment with summary + plan + confidence; user manually starts the session).

name: devin.integrations.cfg.jira.label-matching
observations: jira.devin-label-matching: Match semantics for the generic 'devin' label trigger in Jira. Standalone-word match: `devin`, `Devin`, `devin-workshop`, `devin-task` trigger; `devinworkshop` and `devin_workshop` do NOT.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.support.enterprise-email
observations: support.enterprise-support-email: Cognition enterprise-support contact. Used for self-hosted SCM/artifact onboarding hand-off and other enterprise integration setup.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.slack.app-container-paid-required
observations: slack.app-container-requires-paid-plan: The Slack AI assistant sidebar (app container) experience requires a paid Slack plan. All other Devin Slack features (@mentions, /ask-devin, /dana, message shortcuts) work on any plan including free workspaces.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.alb.layer
observations: load-balancer.alb.layer: Application Load Balancer layer. HTTP/HTTPS. NATs source IPs — backends see the ALB's internal IP, not Devin's source IP.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.nlb.layer
observations: load-balancer.nlb.layer: Network Load Balancer layer. TCP. Preserves source IPs — backends see Devin's actual source IPs.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.tls.required-port
observations: self-hosted-network.tls-port: Required port for HTTPS traffic from Devin to self-hosted endpoints.

name: devin.integrations.cfg.dns-change.json
observations: self-hosted-network.dns-change.json: AWS Route 53 change-batch JSON file format. Used during self-hosted SCM/artifact onboarding to publish a DNS record pointing at the load balancer.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.devin-mcp.base-url
observations: devin-mcp-server.base-url: Base server URL for the authenticated Devin MCP server. Streamable HTTP endpoint at /mcp; legacy SSE /sse deprecated.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.devin-mcp.endpoint-mcp
observations: devin-mcp-server.endpoint: Recommended Streamable HTTP endpoint for Devin MCP server. Full URL: https://mcp.devin.ai/mcp.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.devin-mcp.endpoint-sse-deprecated
observations: devin-mcp-server.endpoint-sse: Legacy SSE endpoint — DEPRECATED. Migrate clients to /mcp.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.deepwiki-mcp.base-url
observations: deepwiki-mcp-server.base-url: Base server URL for the free no-auth DeepWiki MCP server. Public repos only.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.deepwiki-mcp.endpoint-mcp
observations: deepwiki-mcp-server.endpoint: Recommended Streamable HTTP endpoint for DeepWiki MCP server.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.devin-mcp.api-key-prefix
observations: devin-mcp-auth.api-key-prefix: Prefix Devin MCP auth tokens use. Three flavors share this prefix: org-scoped service-user keys (auto-resolves org), enterprise service-user keys (need X-Org-Id), personal access tokens (need X-Org-Id).

name: devin.mcp.cfg.devin-mcp.legacy-prefix-unsupported
observations: devin-mcp-auth.legacy-prefix-unsupported: Legacy API key prefixes that are NOT accepted by Devin MCP server. Customers using these must rotate to a `cog_`-prefixed service-user key first.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.devin-mcp.x-org-id-header
observations: devin-mcp-auth.X-Org-Id: Required header for enterprise service-user keys + PATs. Specifies which Devin organization to target. Org-scoped service-user keys auto-resolve the org and don't need this header.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.universal-image
observations: database-toolbox.image: Universal Database Toolbox Docker image. One image for all 22+ database integrations.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.flag.prebuilt
observations: database-toolbox-flag.--prebuilt: Database Toolbox CLI flag selecting a built-in DB configuration. Valid values: alloydb-postgres, bigquery, cloud-sql-mysql, cloud-sql-postgres, cloud-sql-mssql, dataplex, firestore, looker, mysql, postgres, spanner, mssql.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.flag.tools-file
observations: database-toolbox-flag.--tools-file: Database Toolbox CLI flag pointing to a custom tools-config YAML. Used by Bigtable, Couchbase, Dgraph, MongoDB, Neo4j, Redis, Redshift, Snowflake, SQLite, TiDB, Valkey.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.flag.stdio
observations: database-toolbox-flag.--stdio: Required Database Toolbox CLI flag for MCP STDIO transport.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.alloydb.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.ALLOYDB_POSTGRES_*: AlloyDB env-var family: ALLOYDB_POSTGRES_PROJECT, _REGION, _CLUSTER, _INSTANCE, _DATABASE, _USER, _PASSWORD. Plus GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing at a service-account JSON.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.bigquery.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.BIGQUERY_*: BigQuery env-var family: BIGQUERY_PROJECT (required), BIGQUERY_DATASET (required), BIGQUERY_LOCATION (optional, default 'US'), GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_PATH.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.bigtable.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.BIGTABLE_*: Bigtable env-var family (custom YAML mode): BIGTABLE_PROJECT, _INSTANCE, _TABLE, BIGTABLE_TOOLS_FILE, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_PATH.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.cloud-sql-mysql.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.CLOUD_SQL_MYSQL_*: Cloud SQL for MySQL env-var family: CLOUD_SQL_MYSQL_PROJECT, _REGION, _INSTANCE, _DATABASE, _USER, _IP_ADDRESS, _PASSWORD; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.cloud-sql-postgres.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_*: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL env-var family: CLOUD_SQL_POSTGRES_PROJECT, _REGION, _INSTANCE, _DATABASE, _USER, _IP_ADDRESS, _PASSWORD; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.cloud-sql-mssql.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.CLOUD_SQL_MSSQL_*: Cloud SQL for SQL Server env-var family: CLOUD_SQL_MSSQL_PROJECT, _REGION, _INSTANCE, _DATABASE, _USER, _IP_ADDRESS, _PASSWORD; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.couchbase.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.COUCHBASE_*: Couchbase env-var family (custom YAML mode): COUCHBASE_HOST, _PORT (default 8091), _BUCKET, _USERNAME, _PASSWORD, COUCHBASE_TOOLS_FILE.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.dataplex.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.DATAPLEX_*: Dataplex env-var family: DATAPLEX_PROJECT, DATAPLEX_LOCATION, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing at service-account JSON. Special: supports inline DATAPLEX_CREDENTIALS_JSON via mktemp + bind-mount pattern.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.postgres.env.host
observations: database-toolbox-env.POSTGRES_HOST: PostgreSQL host. Required for prebuilt postgres mode.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.postgres.env.database
observations: database-toolbox-env.POSTGRES_DATABASE: PostgreSQL database name. Required.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.postgres.env.user
observations: database-toolbox-env.POSTGRES_USER: PostgreSQL username. Required.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.postgres.env.password
observations: database-toolbox-env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: PostgreSQL password. Required. Pass via Devin Secrets, not hardcoded in args.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.spanner.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.SPANNER_*: Spanner env-var family: SPANNER_PROJECT, SPANNER_INSTANCE, SPANNER_DATABASE; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.firestore.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.FIRESTORE_*: Firestore env-var family: FIRESTORE_PROJECT (required), FIRESTORE_DATABASE (optional, default '(default)'), GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.toolbox.looker.env
observations: database-toolbox-env.LOOKER_*: Looker env-var family: LOOKER_BASE_URL, LOOKER_CLIENT_ID, LOOKER_CLIENT_SECRET.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.env.url
observations: metabase-mcp-env.METABASE_URL: Required. URL to the Metabase instance, e.g., https://metabase.acme.com.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.env.api-key
observations: metabase-mcp-env.METABASE_API_KEY: Preferred Metabase auth. API key. When set, the server logs 'Using Metabase API Key'.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.env.username
observations: metabase-mcp-env.METABASE_USERNAME: Fallback Metabase auth (with METABASE_PASSWORD). Used when METABASE_API_KEY is not set.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.env.password
observations: metabase-mcp-env.METABASE_PASSWORD: Fallback Metabase auth (with METABASE_USERNAME).

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.flag.essential
observations: metabase-mcp-flag.--essential: Default Metabase MCP tool-loading mode. Loads only essential tools (smaller curated set).

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.flag.all
observations: metabase-mcp-flag.--all: Metabase MCP tool-loading flag. Load all 80+ available tools.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.flag.read
observations: metabase-mcp-flag.--read: Metabase MCP tool-loading flag. Load only read-only tools. Recommended for production-data scenarios.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.flag.write
observations: metabase-mcp-flag.--write: Metabase MCP tool-loading flag. Load only write/modification tools.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.metabase.node-version
observations: metabase-mcp.node-version-recommended: Recommended Node.js version for Metabase MCP server. npm >= 8.0.0 also recommended.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.datadog.headers
observations: marketplace-mcp-headers.Datadog: DD-API-KEY + DD-APPLICATION-KEY: Datadog MCP server requires two HTTP headers: DD-API-KEY (Organization Settings > API Keys) and DD-APPLICATION-KEY (Organization Settings > Application Keys).

name: devin.mcp.cfg.slack-marketplace.bot-token
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Slack: bot token (xoxb-): Slack MCP requires a Bot User OAuth Token (starts 'xoxb-'). Found at api.slack.com/apps > <your app> > OAuth & Permissions. Requires app-level tokens + at least 1 scope + workspace install.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.slack-marketplace.team-id
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Slack: team ID: Slack workspace team ID. Retrieve via `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xoxb-..." https://slack.com/api/auth.test`.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.slack-marketplace.channel-ids
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Slack: channel IDs: Slack channel IDs. Retrieve via conversations.list. Requires bot scopes channels:read, groups:read, mpim:read, im:read.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.supabase.pat
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Supabase: PAT: Supabase MCP requires a personal access token from supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.figma.api-key
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Figma: API key: Figma MCP requires an API key from Profile > Settings > Security > Personal access tokens. Recommended scopes: read on File content + Dev resources.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.stripe.bearer
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Stripe: Authorization Bearer <api-key>: Stripe MCP requires Authorization header in the format `Bearer <STRIPE_API_KEY>`.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.zapier.bearer
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Zapier: Authorization Bearer <token>: Zapier MCP requires Authorization Bearer token. Extract from the server URL at https://mcp.zapier.com/mcp/servers > Connect (the **** segment of the server URL).

name: devin.mcp.cfg.airtable.api-key
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Airtable: API key: Airtable MCP requires an API key from airtable.com/create/tokens.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.dockerhub.creds
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Docker Hub: username + PAT: Docker Hub MCP requires a username (My Hub) and Personal Access Token (Account settings > Personal access tokens).

name: devin.mcp.cfg.sonarqube.creds
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.SonarQube: token + org + URL: SonarQube MCP requires three: API token (My Account > Security), org name (your username), URL (self-hosted: http://localhost:9000 or https://sonarqube.<co>; SonarCloud: https://sonarcloud.io).

name: devin.mcp.cfg.netlify.pat
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Netlify: PAT: Netlify MCP requires a Personal Access Token from app.netlify.com/user/applications#personal-access-tokens. Copy on creation — won't be shown again.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.pulumi.access-token
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Pulumi: access token: Pulumi MCP requires an access token from the Access tokens section in the Pulumi dashboard sidebar.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.heroku.api-key
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Heroku: API key: Heroku MCP requires an API key from https://dashboard.heroku.com/account.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.circleci.token
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.CircleCI: CIRCLECI_TOKEN + CIRCLECI_BASE_URL: CircleCI MCP requires CIRCLECI_TOKEN env var (created at app.circleci.com/settings/user/tokens; copy on creation, won't show again). Optional CIRCLECI_BASE_URL (default 'https://circleci.com'; on-prem customers must set).

name: devin.mcp.cfg.cortex.token
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Cortex: PAT: Cortex MCP requires a personal access token from Settings > My access tokens. Default API URL: https://api.getcortexapp.com.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.square.bearer
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Square: Authorization Bearer <token>: Square MCP requires an Authorization Bearer header with a Square access token.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.hubspot.token
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.HubSpot: private app access token: HubSpot MCP requires an access token. Create a private app: Settings > Integrations > Private Apps > Create private app > set scopes > copy token from the Auth tab.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.redis.creds
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Redis: host + port + username + password: Redis MCP requires Redis host, port, username, password.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.google-maps.api-key
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Google Maps: API key + per-API enables: Google Maps MCP requires an API key (console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials) AND each individual Google Maps API enabled in the project.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.firecrawl.api-key
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.FIRECRAWL_API_KEY: Firecrawl MCP requires API key from firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.elasticsearch.url
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.ES_URL: Elasticsearch URL/endpoint, found on the /overview page in Elasticsearch.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.elasticsearch.api-key
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.ES_API_KEY: Elasticsearch API key, created on the /indices/index_details/<name>/data page.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.elasticsearch.skip-ssl-verify
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.ES_SSL_SKIP_VERIFY: Elasticsearch optional flag. When `true`, skips SSL/TLS certificate verification when connecting.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.postgres-marketplace.connection-string
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Postgres MCP: connection string: Marketplace Postgres MCP requires only the Postgres connection string. Use a read-only connection or restricted-permission user for production data.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.grafana.creds
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Grafana: URL + service-account token: Grafana MCP requires Grafana URL and a service-account token. Create at Administration > Users and access > Service accounts > Add service account > Add service account token.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.pinecone.api-key
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Pinecone: API key: Pinecone MCP requires an API key. NOTE: only Pinecone indexes with INTEGRATED EMBEDDING are supported (as of 7/16/25). External-embedding indexes not yet supported.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.snyk.unmanaged-flag
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Snyk: unmanaged: true (per-language): Snyk MCP requires `unmanaged: true` flag for some frameworks (e.g., C++) to run scans correctly. Set in knowledge or during a session.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.replicate.api-token
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Replicate: API token: Replicate MCP requires an API token from replicate.com/account/api-tokens.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.parallel.api-key
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Parallel: API key: Parallel MCP requires an API key from platform.parallel.ai.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.plaid.bearer
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Plaid: OAuth Bearer access token: Plaid MCP requires an OAuth Bearer access token. Generate from dashboard.plaid.com/developers/keys.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.playwright.no-config
observations: marketplace-mcp-credentials.Playwright: no env vars: Playwright MCP requires no environment variables. 1-click enable.

name: devin.mcp.cfg.linear-mcp.skip
observations: marketplace-mcp.Linear: skip MCP if integration connected: If the Linear integration is connected, Linear MCP does NOT need to be configured separately. Devin already has native Linear tools using the integration's auth.

name: devin.api.cfg.auth.authorization-header
observations: auth.Authorization: Required HTTP header on every Devin API request. Format: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Token starts with `cog_` (current API) or `apk_user_`/`apk_` (legacy). Same shape for both Service User API Keys and PATs.

name: devin.api.cfg.auth.token-prefix-cog
observations: auth.token-prefix: Prefix on all current-API tokens (service-user keys + PATs).

name: devin.api.cfg.auth.legacy-prefix-apk
observations: auth.legacy-token-prefix: Legacy v1/v2 token prefixes. Continue working during deprecation period; not accepted by Devin MCP server.

name: devin.api.cfg.session.body.prompt
observations: session-create-body.prompt: Required body field on Create Session. Initial agent instruction.

name: devin.api.cfg.session.body.title
observations: session-create-body.title: Optional human-readable title for the session.

name: devin.api.cfg.session.body.playbook
observations: session-create-body.playbook: Optional playbook ID. When set, applies the playbook's instructions to the session.

name: devin.api.cfg.session.body.tags
observations: session-create-body.tags: Optional tags to apply at creation. Must be in the org's allowed tags list.

name: devin.api.cfg.session.body.acu-limit
observations: session-create-body.acu_limit: Optional Agent Compute Unit cap for the session. Session terminates when limit is reached.

name: devin.api.cfg.session.body.create-as-user-id
observations: session-create-body.create_as_user_id: Optional user ID. When set, attributes the session to that user (appears in their list, counts toward their usage). Requires ImpersonateOrgSessions permission.

name: devin.api.cfg.pagination.first
observations: pagination.first: Cursor pagination page-size parameter. Default varies by endpoint.

name: devin.api.cfg.pagination.after
observations: pagination.after: Cursor pagination — opaque cursor from a previous response's end_cursor. Omit for the first page.

name: devin.api.cfg.pagination.has-next-page
observations: pagination-response.has_next_page: Pagination response field. True if more results follow.

name: devin.api.cfg.pagination.end-cursor
observations: pagination-response.end_cursor: Pagination response field. Pass as `after` for the next page. Null when has_next_page is false.

name: devin.api.cfg.pagination.total
observations: pagination-response.total: Pagination response field. Total matching items count. May be omitted for performance reasons.

name: devin.api.cfg.knowledge.body.name
observations: knowledge-note-body.name: Knowledge note name field.

name: devin.api.cfg.knowledge.body.trigger
observations: knowledge-note-body.trigger: Knowledge note trigger condition (when this knowledge applies).

name: devin.api.cfg.knowledge.body.body
observations: knowledge-note-body.body: Knowledge note content body.

name: devin.api.cfg.playbook.body.name
observations: playbook-body.name: Playbook name.

name: devin.api.cfg.playbook.body.instructions
observations: playbook-body.instructions: Playbook body / instructions.

name: devin.api.cfg.playbook.body.macro
observations: playbook-body.macro: Optional macro identifier (e.g., `!plan`). Required for label-based triggers in Jira/Linear/Slack.

name: devin.api.cfg.schedule.body.cron-schedule
observations: schedule-body.cron_schedule: Cron expression. Standard 5-field format. Example: `0 9 * * 1-5` = 9am every weekday.

name: devin.api.cfg.schedule.body.timezone
observations: schedule-body.timezone: IANA timezone for cron-schedule interpretation. Example: 'America/New_York'.

name: devin.api.cfg.schedule.body.is-enabled
observations: schedule-body.is_enabled: Whether the schedule is active. Toggle off to pause without deleting.

name: devin.api.cfg.base-url.api-default
observations: base-url.api-default: Default Devin API base URL.

name: devin.api.cfg.base-url.app
observations: base-url.app-default: Default Devin web-app URL. Session URLs returned by the API have the form `https://app.devin.ai/sessions/<id>`.

name: devin.api.cfg.base-url.enterprise-custom-domain
observations: base-url.enterprise-custom-domain-pattern: Custom enterprise API domain pattern. Replace api.devin.ai with the customer's domain (e.g., api.your-company.devinenterprise.com) for dedicated-deployment Enterprise customers.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.read-account-meta
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ReadAccountMeta: Default-granted to all service users. Controls /v3/self.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-enterprise-settings
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageEnterpriseSettings: Controls audit logs + organization tags.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-organizations
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageOrganizations: Controls Organizations CRUD + Organization group limits.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-account-membership
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageAccountMembership: Controls Roles, Enterprise users, Enterprise IdP groups, Enterprise service-user membership, IdP-group registration.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-account-service-users
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageAccountServiceUsers: Controls service-user provisioning at the enterprise level.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-account-knowledge
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageAccountKnowledge: Controls enterprise-level knowledge notes.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-account-playbooks
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageAccountPlaybooks: Controls enterprise-level playbooks.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-git-integrations
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageGitIntegrations: Controls Git connections + Git permissions.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-billing
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageBilling: Controls consumption cycles + daily consumption breakdowns.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.view-account-metrics
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ViewAccountMetrics: Controls usage metrics (DAU/WAU/MAU, PRs, sessions, searches, active users) + queue status.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.view-enterprise-infra-details
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ViewEnterpriseInfraDetails: Controls hypervisors endpoint.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.view-account-sessions
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ViewAccountSessions: Controls enterprise-scoped session list + detail (read-only). Inherits to ViewOrgSessions in all orgs.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-account-sessions
observations: rbac-permission-enterprise.ManageAccountSessions: Controls sending messages to sessions at the enterprise level.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-org-secrets
observations: rbac-permission-org.ManageOrgSecrets: Controls secrets CRUD at the org level.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-org-knowledge
observations: rbac-permission-org.ManageOrgKnowledge: Controls org-level knowledge notes.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-org-playbooks
observations: rbac-permission-org.ManageOrgPlaybooks: Controls org-level playbooks.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-org-service-users
observations: rbac-permission-org.ManageOrgServiceUsers: Controls org-level service-user provisioning.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-org-schedules
observations: rbac-permission-org.ManageOrgSchedules: Controls scheduled sessions.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.view-org-sessions
observations: rbac-permission-org.ViewOrgSessions: Controls org-scoped session list + detail (read-only).

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.manage-org-sessions
observations: rbac-permission-org.ManageOrgSessions: Controls sending messages, terminating, archiving sessions in an org.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.use-devin-sessions
observations: rbac-permission-org.UseDevinSessions: Controls creating sessions.

name: devin.api.cfg.permission.impersonate-org-sessions
observations: rbac-permission-org.ImpersonateOrgSessions: Controls creating sessions on behalf of other users (`create_as_user_id`).

name: devin.api.cfg.error.200
observations: http-status.200: Successful request.

name: devin.api.cfg.error.201
observations: http-status.201: Resource created successfully.

name: devin.api.cfg.error.400
observations: http-status.400: Invalid request parameters.

name: devin.api.cfg.error.401
observations: http-status.401: Missing or invalid API key.

name: devin.api.cfg.error.403
observations: http-status.403: Insufficient permissions.

name: devin.api.cfg.error.404
observations: http-status.404: Resource not found.

name: devin.api.cfg.error.429
observations: http-status.429: Rate limit exceeded.

name: devin.api.cfg.error.500
observations: http-status.500: Server error.

name: devin.api.cfg.env-var.devin-api-key
observations: env-var-convention.DEVIN_API_KEY: Recommended env var for storing the service-user API key. Used in all common-flows examples.

name: devin.api.cfg.env-var.devin-org-id
observations: env-var-convention.DEVIN_ORG_ID: Recommended env var for the org ID. Found on Settings > Service Users where the key was created.

name: devin.api.cfg.self-response.principal-type
observations: self-response.principal_type: GET /v3/self response field. Values: 'service_user', 'user'.

name: devin.api.cfg.self-response.service-user-id
observations: self-response.service_user_id: Populated when principal_type='service_user'.

name: devin.api.cfg.self-response.org-id
observations: self-response.org_id: Populated for org-scoped service users; null for enterprise-scoped service users (which span orgs).

name: devin.api.cfg.recommendation.least-privilege
observations: security-best-practice.least-privilege: Apply the minimum permissions required when assigning service-user roles.

name: devin.api.cfg.recommendation.key-rotation
observations: security-best-practice.key-rotation: Rotate keys regularly — generate new keys + revoke old ones periodically.

name: devin.api.cfg.recommendation.secret-storage
observations: security-best-practice.secret-storage: Store API keys in env vars or secret-management systems — never in source code.

name: devin.api.cfg.recommendation.audit-monitoring
observations: security-best-practice.audit-monitoring: Review audit logs for unexpected API activity.

name: devin.api.cfg.recommendation.compromised-key
observations: security-best-practice.compromised-key-action: Revoke compromised keys immediately and generate a new one.

name: devin.api.cfg.poll.terminal-states
observations: session-poll.terminal-states: Session statuses at which polling should stop. Common-flows example breaks out of the polling loop on any of these.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.deployment.brain-location
observations: deployment.brain.location: Brain ALWAYS resides in Cognition Cloud, regardless of deployment model. Customer cannot run Devin's brain locally.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.deployment.devbox-location
observations: deployment.devbox.location: DevBox runs in Cognition Cloud (Enterprise Cloud deployment) OR customer-dedicated single-tenant VPC (Customer Dedicated Deployment).

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.deployment.network-setup-cloud
observations: deployment.network.cloud: Enterprise Cloud deployment networking. Customer endpoints must be public OR support IP allowlisting.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.deployment.network-setup-dedicated
observations: deployment.network.dedicated: Customer Dedicated Deployment networking. Preferred: AWS PrivateLink. Alternative: IPSec tunnel. Supports MFA VPN and OpenVPN to internal resources.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.deployment.mfa-vpn-cloud-incompatible
observations: deployment.mfa-vpn.cloud-deployment: MFA VPNs are NOT compatible with Enterprise Cloud deployment. Customers requiring MFA VPN access must use Customer Dedicated Deployment.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.network.devinapps-com
observations: network.*.devinapps.com: End-user workstation outbound connectivity requirement. Domain serves IDE / VSCode frontend and Desktop / browser viewer iframes. Corporate proxies/firewalls must allowlist.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.network.cross-tenant-port
observations: network.cross-tenant-port: Port for cross-tenant communication. HTTPS only. WebSocket on top of HTTPS/443.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.rollout.testing
observations: rollout-mode.testing: Rollout mode: only opted-in orgs use blueprints. Reversible.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.rollout.available
observations: rollout-mode.available: Rollout mode: org admins on classic see migration callout; can self-service migrate.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.rollout.enabled-by-default
observations: rollout-mode.enabled-by-default: Rollout mode: new orgs default to blueprints. PERMANENT — only Cognition admin can undo.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.use-deepwiki
observations: org-level-permission.Use DeepWiki: Org-level permission. Access to DeepWiki functionality.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.use-ask-devin
observations: org-level-permission.Use Ask Devin: Org-level permission. Access to Ask Devin feature.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.use-devin-sessions
observations: org-level-permission.Use Devin Sessions: Org-level permission. Create and use Devin sessions.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-membership
observations: org-level-permission.Manage Membership: Org-level permission. Add/remove users and groups; assign or unassign permission roles.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-settings
observations: org-level-permission.Manage Settings: Org-level permission. Manage settings at the organization level.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-playbooks
observations: org-level-permission.Manage Playbooks: Org-level permission. Create/edit/delete organization playbooks.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-secrets
observations: org-level-permission.Manage Secrets: Org-level permission. Create/edit/delete organization secrets.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-knowledge
observations: org-level-permission.Manage Knowledge: Org-level permission. Create/edit/delete organization knowledge.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-snapshots
observations: org-level-permission.Manage Snapshots: Org-level permission. Create/edit/delete machine snapshots.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.index-repositories
observations: org-level-permission.Index Repositories: Org-level permission. Index repositories for AskDevin and DeepWiki generation.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-sessions
observations: org-level-permission.Manage Sessions (org): Org-level permission. Edit Devin sessions from other users in the organization.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.view-sessions
observations: org-level-permission.View Sessions (org): Org-level permission. View Devin sessions from other users in the organization.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-api-keys
observations: org-level-permission.Manage API Keys: Org-level permission. Create/delete/use API keys.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.manage-mcp-servers
observations: org-level-permission.Manage MCP Servers: Org-level permission. Create/edit/delete MCP servers.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.org-perm.view-metrics

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.builtin-role.org-member
observations: builtin-role-org.Member (org): Built-in org-level role. Standard user access with core functionality.

name: devin.enterprise.cfg.builtin-role.account-admin
